# Baza je ažurirana 14.02.2024.

Baza je ažurirana 14.02.2024.  
zaključno sa NN 17/24
Temelj i ograničenje kaznenopravne prisile

## Članak 1

Kaznena djela i kaznenopravne sankcije propisuju se samo za ona ponašanja kojima se tako povređuju ili ugrožavaju osobne slobode i prava čovjeka te druga prava i društvene vrijednosti zajamčene i zaštićene Ustavom Republike Hrvatske i međunarodnim pravom da se njihova zaštita ne bi mogla ostvariti bez kaznenopravne prisile.  
Načelo zakonitosti

## Članak 2

Nitko ne može biti kažnjen za djelo koje prije nego je počinjeno nije bilo utvrđeno zakonom ili međunarodnim pravom kao kazneno djelo, niti mu se može izreći kazna ili druga kaznenopravna sankcija koja nije bila određena zakonom.  
Načelo primjene blažeg zakona i vremensko važenje kaznenog zakonodavstva

## Članak 3

(1) Prema počinitelju se primjenjuje zakon koji je bio na snazi u vrijeme kad je kazneno djelo počinjeno.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(2) Ako se zakon nakon počinjenja kaznenog djela, a prije donošenja pravomoćne presude, izmijeni jednom ili više puta, primijenit će se zakon koji je najblaži za počinitelja.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Rješenje, Presuda
(3) Ako se u slučajevima iz stavka 2. ovoga članka izmijeni naziv ili opis kaznenog djela, sud će ispitati postoji li pravni kontinuitet tako da činjenično stanje podvede pod biće odgovarajućeg kaznenog djela iz novog zakona pa ako utvrdi da postoji, primijenit će zakon koji je blaži za počinitelja. Nema kaznenog djela ako pravni kontinuitet ne postoji.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Presuda, PresudaiRješenje, PresudaiRješenje, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Rješenje, Presuda
(4) Izmijeni li se zakon za vrijeme počinjenja kaznenog djela, primijenit će se zakon koji je bio na snazi u vrijeme dovršenja radnje.  
(5) Zakon koji je na snazi samo za određeno vrijeme primijenit će se na kaznena djela počinjena u tom vremenu i nakon njegova prestanka važenja ako zakonom nije drukčije propisano.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Presuda i Rješenje, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda, Presuda
Načelo krivnje

## Članak 4

Nitko ne može biti kažnjen ako nije kriv za počinjeno kazneno djelo.  
Načelo oduzimanja imovinske koristi

## Članak 5

Nitko ne može zadržati imovinsku korist ostvarenu protupravnom radnjom.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
Primjena Općeg dijela Kaznenog zakona

## Članak 6

Odredbe Općeg dijela ovoga Zakona odnose se na kaznena djela propisana ovim Zakonom i drugim zakonima.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva prema mladim osobama

## Članak 7

(1) Kazneno zakonodavstvo ne primjenjuje se prema djetetu koje u vrijeme počinjenja djela nije navršilo četrnaest godina.  
(2) Prema osobi koja je u vrijeme počinjenja kaznenog djela navršila četrnaest godina, a nije još navršila dvadeset i jednu godinu primjenjuje se ovaj Zakon ako posebnim zakonom nije drukčije propisano.  
Vrijeme počinjenja kaznenog djela

## Članak 8

(1) Kazneno djelo je počinjeno u vrijeme kad je počinitelj poduzeo radnju ili je bio dužan poduzeti radnju, bez obzira na to kad je nastupila posljedica iz zakonskog opisa kaznenog djela.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(2) Sastoji li se počiniteljeva djelatnost iz više vremenski odvojenih radnji, djelo je počinjeno danom posljednje radnje, a kod kaznenih djela kod kojih radnja traje, danom prestanka radnje.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Presuda, Presuda
Mjesto počinjenja kaznenog djela

## Članak 9

(1) Kazneno djelo počinjeno je u mjestu gdje je počinitelj radio ili bio dužan raditi i u mjestu gdje je u cijelosti ili djelomično nastupila posljedica iz zakonskog opisa kaznenog djela ili je prema njegovoj zamisli trebala nastupiti.  
(2) U slučajevima sudioništva kazneno je djelo počinjeno u mjestu određenom u stavku 1. ovoga članka i u mjestu gdje je bilo koji od sudionika radio ili bio dužan raditi ili gdje je prema njegovoj zamisli posljedica iz zakonskog opisa kaznenog djela trebala nastupiti.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za kaznena djela počinjena na području Republike Hrvatske

## Članak 10

Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se na svakoga tko počini kazneno djelo na njezinu području.  
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za kaznena djela počinjena na brodu ili zrakoplovu Republike Hrvatske

## Članak 11

Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se i na svakoga tko počini kazneno djelo na domaćem brodu ili zrakoplovu, bez obzira na to gdje se brod ili zrakoplov nalazi u vrijeme počinjenja kaznenog djela.  
Posebnosti glede pokretanja kaznenog postupka za kaznena djela počinjena na području Republike Hrvatske, njezinom brodu ili zrakoplovu
Kad je u slučaju primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske prema odredbama članka 10. i članka 11. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak pravomoćno dovršen u stranoj državi, kazneni postupak u Republici Hrvatskoj pokrenut će se po odobrenju glavnog državnog odvjetnika.  
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za kaznena djela počinjena izvan Republike Hrvatske protiv njezinog pravnog interesa

## Članak 13

Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se prema svakome tko izvan njezina područja počini:
1. kazneno djelo protiv Republike Hrvatske iz Glave XXXII. ovoga Zakona,
2. kazneno djelo krivotvorenja novca, vrijednosnih papira i znakova za vrijednost Republike Hrvatske iz članka 274., članka 275. i članka 276. ovoga Zakona,
3. kazneno djelo protiv hrvatskog državnog dužnosnika ili službenika u vezi s njegovom službom,
4. kazneno djelo davanja lažnog iskaza iz članka 305. ovoga Zakona, ako je lažni iskaz dan u postupku pred hrvatskim nadležnim tijelima,
5. kaznena djela protiv biračkog prava iz Glave XXXI. ovoga Zakona,
6. kazneno djelo iz članka 193., članka 194., članka 196., članka 197. i članka 198. ovoga Zakona kad je počinjeno u zaštićenom ekološko-ribolovnom pojasu, epikontinentalnom pojasu ili na otvorenom moru.  
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za kaznena djela koja izvan područja Republike Hrvatske počine njezini državljani
(1) Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se prema hrvatskom državljaninu i osobi koja ima prebivalište u Republici Hrvatskoj, koja izvan područja Republike Hrvatske počini bilo koje drugo kazneno djelo osim onih koja su obuhvaćena odredbama iz članka 13. i članka 16. ovoga Zakona, ako je to kazneno djelo kažnjivo i prema zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno.  
(2) Odredba stavka 1. ovoga članka primijenit će se i kad počinitelj stekne hrvatsko državljanstvo nakon počinjenja kaznenog djela.  
(3) U slučajevima iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka kod kaznenih djela iz članka 115. stavka 3. i 4., članka 116., članka 153., članka 154., članka 158., članka 159., članka 161., članka 162., članka 163., članka 164., članka 166. i članka 169. ovoga Zakona te drugih kaznenih djela kod kojih je to predviđeno međunarodnim ugovorom kojeg je Republika Hrvatska stranka, kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primijenit će se i kad kazneno djelo nije kažnjivo prema zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno.  
(4) Kad hrvatski državljani sudjeluju u mirovnim operacijama ili drugim međunarodnim aktivnostima izvan područja Republike Hrvatske i u takvim operacijama ili aktivnostima počine kazneno djelo, primjena zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske ravnat će se prema odredbama ovog Zakona, ako međunarodnim ugovorom kojeg je Republika Hrvatska stranka nije predviđeno drugačije.  
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za kaznena djela počinjena protiv državljanina Republike Hrvatske izvan njezina područja

Basis and limitation of criminal law coercion

## Article 1

Criminal offences and criminal law sanctions are prescribed only for those behaviours which violate or endanger personal freedoms and human rights and other rights and social values guaranteed and protected by the Constitution of the Republic of Croatia and international law to such an extent that their protection could not be achieved without criminal law coercion.  
Principle of legality

## Article 2

No one may be punished for an act which, before it was committed, was not defined by law or international law as a criminal offence, nor may a penalty or other criminal law sanction be imposed on them which was not prescribed by law.  
Principle of application of a more lenient law and temporal validity of criminal legislation

## Article 3

(1) The law that was in force at the time when the criminal offence was committed shall be applied to the perpetrator.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
(2) If the law is amended one or more times after the commission of the criminal offence and before the final judgment is rendered, the law that is most lenient for the perpetrator shall be applied.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Decision, Judgment
(3) If in the cases referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article the name or description of the criminal offence is changed, the court shall examine whether legal continuity exists by subsuming the factual situation under the elements of the corresponding criminal offence from the new law, and if it determines that it exists, it shall apply the law that is more lenient for the perpetrator. There is no criminal offence if legal continuity does not exist.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Judgment, JudgmentandDecision, JudgmentandDecision, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Decision, Judgment
(4) If the law is amended during the commission of the criminal offence, the law that was in force at the time of completion of the act shall be applied.  
(5) A law that is in force only for a specified period shall be applied to criminal offences committed during that period even after it ceases to be valid, unless otherwise prescribed by law.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Judgment and Decision, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment
Principle of guilt

## Article 4

No one may be punished unless they are guilty of the committed criminal offence.  
Principle of confiscation of pecuniary gain

## Article 5

No one may retain pecuniary gain obtained by an unlawful act.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
Application of the General Part of the Criminal Code

## Article 6

The provisions of the General Part of this Code apply to criminal offences prescribed by this Code and other laws.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
Application of criminal legislation to young persons

## Article 7

(1) Criminal legislation does not apply to a child who had not reached the age of fourteen at the time of commission of the act.  
(2) This Code shall apply to a person who had reached the age of fourteen but had not yet reached the age of twenty-one at the time of commission of the criminal offence, unless otherwise prescribed by special law.  
Time of commission of a criminal offence

## Article 8

(1) A criminal offence is committed at the time when the perpetrator undertook the act or was obliged to undertake the act, regardless of when the consequence from the statutory description of the criminal offence occurred.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
(2) If the perpetrator's activity consists of several temporally separated acts, the offence is committed on the day of the last act, and in the case of criminal offences where the act is continuous, on the day the act ceases.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Judgment, Judgment
Place of commission of a criminal offence

## Article 9

(1) A criminal offence is committed in the place where the perpetrator acted or was obliged to act and in the place where the consequence from the statutory description of the criminal offence occurred in whole or in part or was supposed to occur according to their intention.  
(2) In cases of complicity, the criminal offence is committed in the place specified in paragraph 1 of this Article and in the place where any of the participants acted or was obliged to act or where, according to their intention, the consequence from the statutory description of the criminal offence was supposed to occur.  
CASE LAW: Decision
Application of criminal legislation for criminal offences committed on the territory of the Republic of Croatia

## Article 10

The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia applies to anyone who commits a criminal offence on its territory.  
Application of criminal legislation for criminal offences committed on a vessel or aircraft of the Republic of Croatia

## Article 11

The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia also applies to anyone who commits a criminal offence on a domestic vessel or aircraft, regardless of where the vessel or aircraft is located at the time of commission of the criminal offence.  
Specificities regarding the initiation of criminal proceedings for criminal offences committed on the territory of the Republic of Croatia, its vessel or aircraft
When, in the case of application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia pursuant to the provisions of Article 10 and Article 11 of this Code, criminal proceedings have been finally concluded in a foreign state, criminal proceedings in the Republic of Croatia shall be initiated with the approval of the Chief State Attorney.  
Application of criminal legislation for criminal offences committed outside the Republic of Croatia against its legal interest

## Article 13

The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia applies to anyone who commits outside its territory:
1. a criminal offence against the Republic of Croatia from Chapter XXXII of this Code,
2. a criminal offence of counterfeiting money, securities and tokens of value of the Republic of Croatia from Article 274, Article 275 and Article 276 of this Code,
3. a criminal offence against a Croatian state official or civil servant in connection with their service,
4. a criminal offence of giving false testimony from Article 305 of this Code, if the false testimony was given in proceedings before Croatian competent authorities,
5. criminal offences against electoral rights from Chapter XXXI of this Code,
6. a criminal offence from Article 193, Article 194, Article 196, Article 197 and Article 198 of this Code when committed in the protected ecological and fisheries zone, the continental shelf or on the high seas.  
Application of criminal legislation for criminal offences committed outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia by its nationals
(1) The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia applies to a Croatian national and a person who has residence in the Republic of Croatia, who commits outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia any other criminal offence except those covered by the provisions of Article 13 and Article 16 of this Code, if that criminal offence is also punishable under the law of the state in which it was committed.  
(2) The provision of paragraph 1 of this Article shall also apply when the perpetrator acquires Croatian citizenship after the commission of the criminal offence.  
(3) In the cases referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, for criminal offences from Article 115 paragraphs 3 and 4, Article 116, Article 153, Article 154, Article 158, Article 159, Article 161, Article 162, Article 163, Article 164, Article 166 and Article 169 of this Code and other criminal offences where this is provided for by an international treaty to which the Republic of Croatia is a party, the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall be applied even when the criminal offence is not punishable under the law of the state in which it was committed.  
(4) When Croatian nationals participate in peace operations or other international activities outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia and commit a criminal offence in such operations or activities, the application of the legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall be governed by the provisions of this Code, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty to which the Republic of Croatia is a party.  
Application of criminal legislation for criminal offences committed against a national of the Republic of Croatia outside its territory

## Članak 15

(1) Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se prema strancu koji izvan područja Republike Hrvatske prema državljaninu Republike Hrvatske, osobi koja ima prebivalište u Republici Hrvatskoj ili pravnoj osobi registriranoj u Republici Hrvatskoj počini bilo koje kazneno djelo koje nije obuhvaćeno odredbom iz članka 13. i članka 16. ovoga Zakona, ako je to kazneno djelo kažnjivo i prema zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno.  
(2) U slučaju iz stavka 1. ovoga članka sud ne može izreći težu kaznu od one koja je propisana zakonom zemlje u kojoj je kazneno djelo počinjeno.  
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za kaznena djela protiv vrijednosti zaštićenih međunarodnim pravom počinjena izvan područja Republike Hrvatske

## Članak 16

Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se prema svakome tko izvan njezina područja počini kazneno djelo iz članka 88., članka 90., članka 91., članka 97., članka 104., članka 105. i članka 106. ovoga Zakona, kao i kazneno djelo koje je Republika Hrvatska prema međunarodnom ugovoru obvezna kažnjavati i kada je počinjeno izvan područja Republike Hrvatske.  
Primjena kaznenog zakonodavstva za ostala kaznena djela počinjena izvan područja Republike Hrvatske

## Članak 17

(1) Kazneno zakonodavstvo Republike Hrvatske primjenjuje se prema strancu koji izvan područja Republike Hrvatske počini kazneno djelo za koje se po hrvatskom zakonodavstvu može izreći kazna zatvora od pet godina ili teža kazna, a ne radi se o slučajevima iz članka 13. do 16. ovoga Zakona, ako je to kazneno djelo kažnjivo i prema zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno i ako je izručenje počinitelja zakonom ili međunarodnim ugovorom dopušteno, ali do njega nije došlo.  
(2) U slučaju iz stavka 1. ovoga članka sud ne može izreći težu kaznu od one koja je propisana zakonom zemlje u kojoj je kazneno djelo počinjeno.  
Posebnosti glede pokretanja kaznenog postupka za kaznena djela počinjena izvan područja Republike Hrvatske
(1) Kad je u slučaju primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske prema odredbama članka 13. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak pravomoćno dovršen u stranoj državi, glavni državni odvjetnik može odustati od kaznenog progona.  
(2) U slučajevima iz članka 14. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak radi primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske neće se pokrenuti:
1. ako je pravomoćnom presudom izrečena kazna izvršena ili je u postupku izvršenja ili više ne može biti izvršena prema zakonu države u kojoj je osoba osuđena,
2. ako je počinitelj u stranoj državi pravomoćnom presudom oslobođen ili mu je kazna po zakonu države u kojoj je kazneno djelo počinio oproštena,
3. ako je nastupila zastara kaznenog progona.  
(3) U slučajevima iz članka 14. stavka 1. i 2. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak radi primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske neće se pokrenuti ako se kazneno djelo po zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno progoni po prijedlogu ili privatnoj tužbi, a takav prijedlog ili tužba nisu podneseni.  
(4) U slučajevima iz članka 14. stavka 3. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak radi primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske pokrenut će se i ako se kazneno djelo po zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno progoni po prijedlogu ili privatnoj tužbi, a takav prijedlog ili tužba nisu podneseni.  
(5) U slučajevima iz članka 15. i članka 17. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak radi primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske neće se pokrenuti:
1. ako je pravomoćnom presudom izrečena kazna izvršena ili je u postupku izvršenja ili više ne može biti izvršena prema zakonu države u kojoj je osoba osuđena,
2. ako je počinitelj u stranoj državi pravomoćnom presudom oslobođen ili mu je kazna po zakonu države u kojoj je kazneno djelo počinio oproštena,
3. ako se kazneno djelo po zakonu države u kojoj je počinjeno progoni po prijedlogu ili privatnoj tužbi, a takav prijedlog ili tužba nisu podneseni, ili je nastupila zastara kaznenog progona.  
(6) U slučaju iz članka 16. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak radi primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske može se pokrenuti ako kazneni progon nije pokrenut pred Međunarodnim kaznenim sudom ili sudom druge države ili ako se ne može očekivati provođenje pravičnog postupka pred sudom države u kojoj je kazneno djelo počinjeno, sudom države čiji je počinitelj državljanin ili drugim sudom koji je nadležan za suđenje. Ako je kazneni postupak proveden u drugoj državi suprotno međunarodno priznatim standardima pravičnog suđenja, kazneni postupak može se pokrenuti samo uz odobrenje glavnog državnog odvjetnika.  
(7) U slučaju iz članka 14., članka 15., članka 16. i članka 17. ovoga Zakona kazneni postupak će se pokrenuti samo ako se počinitelj nalazi na području Republike Hrvatske.  
Posebnosti glede pokretanja kaznenog postupka u odnosu na države ugovornice Konvencije o provedbi Sporazuma iz Schengena

## Članak 18.a (NN 118/18)

Kazneni postupak radi primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske ne može se pokrenuti ako je u državi ugovornici Konvencije o provedbi sporazuma iz Schengena kazneni postupak zbog istog djela i u odnosu na istog počinitelja pravomoćno dovršen pod uvjetom da je, ako je izrečena kazna ta kazna i izvršena ili je trenutačno u postupku izvršenja ili se više, prema zakonima ugovorne stranke koja ju je izrekla, ne može izvršiti.  
Uračunavanje oduzimanja slobode i izvršenih kaznenopravnih sankcija u stranoj državi

## Članak 19

U slučajevima primjene kaznenog zakonodavstva Republike Hrvatske, vrijeme provedeno u pritvoru, istražnom zatvoru ili na izdržavanju kazne, kao i svako drugo oduzimanje slobode u stranoj državi, uračunat će se u kaznu zatvora koju izrekne domaći sud za isto kazneno djelo. Druge izvršene kaznenopravne sankcije uračunat će se prema pravičnoj ocjeni suda.  
Način počinjenja kaznenog djela

## Članak 20

(1) Kazneno djelo može se počiniti činjenjem ili nečinjenjem.  
(2) Tko propusti spriječiti nastupanje zakonom opisane posljedice kaznenog djela odgovarat će za nečinjenje ako je pravno obvezan spriječiti nastupanje takve posljedice i ako je propuštanje po djelovanju i značenju jednako počinjenju tog djela činjenjem.  
(3) Počinitelj koji je kazneno djelo počinio nečinjenjem može se blaže kazniti, osim ako se radi o kaznenom djelu koje se može počiniti samo nečinjenjem.  
Nužna obrana

## Članak 21

(1) Isključena je protupravnost djela počinjenog u nužnoj obrani.  
(2) Nužna je ona obrana koja je prijeko potrebna da se od sebe ili drugoga odbije istodobni ili izravno predstojeći protupravni napad.  
(3) Počinitelj koji prekorači granice nužne obrane može se blaže kazniti.

## Article 15

(1) The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall apply to a foreigner who, outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia, commits against a citizen of the Republic of Croatia, a person who has residence in the Republic of Croatia or a legal person registered in the Republic of Croatia, any criminal offence not covered by the provisions of Article 13 and Article 16 of this Act, if that criminal offence is punishable also under the law of the state in which it was committed.  
(2) In the case referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may not impose a more severe penalty than that prescribed by the law of the country in which the criminal offence was committed.  
Application of criminal legislation for criminal offences against values protected by international law committed outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia

## Article 16

The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall apply to anyone who, outside its territory, commits a criminal offence referred to in Article 88, Article 90, Article 91, Article 97, Article 104, Article 105 and Article 106 of this Act, as well as a criminal offence which the Republic of Croatia is obliged to punish pursuant to an international treaty even when it is committed outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia.  
Application of criminal legislation for other criminal offences committed outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia

## Article 17

(1) The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall apply to a foreigner who, outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia, commits a criminal offence for which, under Croatian legislation, a prison sentence of five years or a more severe penalty may be imposed, and it is not a case referred to in Articles 13 to 16 of this Act, if that criminal offence is punishable also under the law of the state in which it was committed and if the extradition of the perpetrator is permitted by law or international treaty, but has not taken place.  
(2) In the case referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may not impose a more severe penalty than that prescribed by the law of the country in which the criminal offence was committed.  
Specificities regarding the initiation of criminal proceedings for criminal offences committed outside the territory of the Republic of Croatia
(1) When, in the case of application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia pursuant to the provisions of Article 13 of this Act, criminal proceedings have been finally concluded in a foreign state, the Chief State Attorney may waive criminal prosecution.  
(2) In the cases referred to in Article 14 of this Act, criminal proceedings for the application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall not be initiated:
1. if the penalty imposed by a final judgment has been executed or is in the process of execution or can no longer be executed under the law of the state in which the person was convicted,
2. if the perpetrator has been acquitted by a final judgment in a foreign state or the penalty has been pardoned under the law of the state in which the criminal offence was committed,
3. if the statute of limitations for criminal prosecution has expired.  
(3) In the cases referred to in Article 14 paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Act, criminal proceedings for the application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall not be initiated if the criminal offence is prosecuted under the law of the state in which it was committed upon a motion or private action, and such motion or action has not been filed.  
(4) In the cases referred to in Article 14 paragraph 3 of this Act, criminal proceedings for the application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall be initiated even if the criminal offence is prosecuted under the law of the state in which it was committed upon a motion or private action, and such motion or action has not been filed.  
(5) In the cases referred to in Article 15 and Article 17 of this Act, criminal proceedings for the application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia shall not be initiated:
1. if the penalty imposed by a final judgment has been executed or is in the process of execution or can no longer be executed under the law of the state in which the person was convicted,
2. if the perpetrator has been acquitted by a final judgment in a foreign state or the penalty has been pardoned under the law of the state in which the criminal offence was committed,
3. if the criminal offence is prosecuted under the law of the state in which it was committed upon a motion or private action, and such motion or action has not been filed, or the statute of limitations for criminal prosecution has expired.  
(6) In the case referred to in Article 16 of this Act, criminal proceedings for the application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia may be initiated if criminal prosecution has not been initiated before the International Criminal Court or a court of another state or if a fair trial cannot be expected before the court of the state in which the criminal offence was committed, the court of the state of which the perpetrator is a national or another court having jurisdiction to try the case. If criminal proceedings have been conducted in another state contrary to internationally recognised standards of fair trial, criminal proceedings may be initiated only with the approval of the Chief State Attorney.  
(7) In the cases referred to in Article 14, Article 15, Article 16 and Article 17 of this Act, criminal proceedings shall be initiated only if the perpetrator is located in the territory of the Republic of Croatia.  
Specificities regarding the initiation of criminal proceedings in relation to States Parties to the Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement

## Article 18.a (NN 118/18)

Criminal proceedings for the application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia may not be initiated if, in a State Party to the Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement, criminal proceedings for the same act and in relation to the same perpetrator have been finally concluded, provided that, if a penalty was imposed, that penalty has been executed or is currently in the process of execution or can no longer be executed under the laws of the Contracting Party which imposed it.  
Crediting of deprivation of liberty and executed criminal sanctions in a foreign state

## Article 19

In cases of application of the criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia, time spent in detention, investigative detention or serving a sentence, as well as any other deprivation of liberty in a foreign state, shall be credited towards the prison sentence imposed by the domestic court for the same criminal offence. Other executed criminal sanctions shall be credited according to the fair assessment of the court.  
Manner of committing a criminal offence

## Article 20

(1) A criminal offence may be committed by an act or an omission.  
(2) Whoever fails to prevent the occurrence of a consequence of a criminal offence described by law shall be liable for an omission if legally obliged to prevent the occurrence of such consequence and if the omission is, in its effect and significance, equivalent to the commission of that act by an act.  
(3) A perpetrator who has committed a criminal offence by omission may be punished more leniently, unless it is a criminal offence that can only be committed by omission.  
Necessary defence

## Article 21

(1) The unlawfulness of an act committed in necessary defence is excluded.  
(2) Necessary defence is that defence which is urgently needed to repel from oneself or another a simultaneous or directly imminent unlawful attack.  
(3) A perpetrator who exceeds the limits of necessary defence may be punished more leniently.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision, Judgment, Judgment
(4) A person who exceeds the limits of necessary defence due to excusable intense fright caused by the attack is not guilty.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment, Judgment
Extreme necessity

## Article 22

(1) The unlawfulness of an act committed in order to avert from oneself or another a simultaneous danger which could not be averted in another way is excluded if the harm done is less than that which was threatened.  
(2) A person who commits an unlawful act in order to avert from oneself or another a simultaneous danger not caused by fault which could not be averted in another way is not guilty if the harm done was not disproportionately greater than the harm which was threatened and if the person was not obliged to expose himself or herself to the danger. If such person was obliged to expose himself or herself to the danger, he or she may be punished more leniently.  
(3) If the perpetrator was in a removable error regarding the circumstances referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article which exclude guilt, he or she shall be punished according to the rules on negligence when the law prescribes punishment for the committed act for negligence.  
Elements of guilt

## Article 23

A perpetrator is guilty of a criminal offence if, at the time of committing the criminal offence, he or she was of sound mind, acted with intent or negligence, was aware or was obliged and able to be aware that his or her act was prohibited, and no excusing reason exists.

## Article 24

(1) A person lacking criminal capacity is not guilty and cannot be punished.  
(2) A person lacking criminal capacity is a person who at the time of committing the unlawful act was unable to comprehend the meaning of their conduct or was unable to control their will due to mental illness, temporary mental disturbance, insufficient mental development or some other serious mental disorder.

## Article 25

A perpetrator who through the use of alcohol, drugs or in another manner through their own fault brought themselves into a state in which they were unable to comprehend the meaning of their conduct or were unable to control their will shall not be considered as lacking criminal capacity, if at the time when they were bringing themselves into such a state the criminal offence they committed was covered by their intent or if there was negligence on their part regarding that criminal offence, and the law prescribes punishability for that form of culpability as well.

## Article 64. (144/12)

(1) The court shall order protective supervision for the perpetrator when it assesses that he needs assistance, guidance and supervision of the competent probation authority so that he does not commit criminal offences in the future and so that he can more easily integrate into society.  
(2) Protective supervision is based on an individual treatment programme which is prepared, assisted in implementation and whose implementation is supervised by the competent probation authority.

Mandatory psychiatric treatment

## Članak 68. (NN 56/15)

(1) The court shall impose the security measure of mandatory psychiatric treatment on a perpetrator who has committed a criminal offense for which a prison sentence of one year or more is prescribed in a state of substantially diminished accountability if there is a danger that this person, due to mental disturbances which caused their substantially diminished accountability, could commit a more serious criminal offense in the future.  
(2) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article imposed together with a prison sentence shall be executed within the prison system. The measure imposed together with a fine, community service and a suspended sentence shall be executed outside the prison system under the supervision of the competent probation authority.  
(3) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article may last until the completion of execution of the prison sentence or community service, the expiry of the probation period in the application of a suspended sentence, or until the expiry of the prison sentence time corresponding to the imposed fine.  
(4) The court must, upon the expiry of the first year from the perpetrator's commencement of execution of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article and thereafter at least once annually, review whether the conditions from paragraph 1 of this Article exist for its continuation and issue a decision thereon. At the request of the institution in which the measure is being implemented, the competent probation office or at the request of the perpetrator, this review may be carried out earlier, but not before the expiry of six months from the last review. The court may suspend the application of the measure or change the manner and time of execution of the measure.  
(5) The court shall suspend the execution of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article if the reasons for which it was imposed have ceased.

## Članak 71. (144/12, 56/15, 84/21)

SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda
(2) Mjera iz stavka 1. ovoga članka izriče se u trajanju od jedne do deset godina. Počinitelju koji je osuđen na kaznu zatvora, a nije mu izrečena uvjetna osuda niti je kazna zatvora zamijenjena radom za opće dobro, mjera iz stavka 1. ovoga članka izreći će se u trajanju koje je od jedne do deset godina dulje od izrečene kazne zatvora.  
(3) Počinitelju kaznenog djela iz članka 105. stavka 3., članka 106. stavka 2. i 3., članka 111. točke 2., članka 112. stavka 1., članka 114., članka 116., članka 118., članka 119., članka 120., Glave XVI., počinjenog na štetu djeteta i Glave XVII. ovoga Zakona, sud će izreći zabranu obavljanja dužnosti ili djelatnosti u kojima dolazi u redoviti kontakt s djecom i kad ova djela nisu će počinjena u obavljanju dužnosti i djelatnosti, ako postoji opasnost da će zlouporabom te dužnosti ili djelatnosti ponovno počiniti ta kaznena djela, a može je izreći i doživotno.  
(4) Za vrijeme zabrane iz stavka 1. ovoga članka osuđenik se ne smije baviti određenom dužnosti ili djelatnosti samostalno, za drugu osobu, u pravnoj osobi, ni u ime druge osobe, niti smije ovlastiti drugu osobu da se bavi tom dužnošću ili djelatnošću u njegovo ime i po njegovim uputama.  
(5) Ako počinitelj ne postupi prema zabrani obavljanja određene dužnosti ili djelatnosti kad je izrečena uz rad za opće dobro, uvjetnu osudu, ili za vrijeme uvjetnog otpusta shodno će se primijeniti odredbe članka 55. stavka 9., članka 58. stavka 5. ili članka 61. stavka 3. ovoga Zakona.  
(6) Po proteku polovine trajanja sigurnosne mjere izrečene na temelju stavka 1. ovoga članka, sud može na prijedlog osuđenika obustaviti njeno izvršenje ako ustanovi da više ne postoji opasnost iz stavka 1. ovoga članka. Osuđenik može ponoviti prijedlog, ali ne prije proteka jedne godine od zadnjeg preispitivanja.  
(7) Po proteku najdužeg vremena iz stavka 2. ovoga članka sigurnosnu mjeru izrečenu na temelju stavka 3. ovoga članka sud može na prijedlog osuđenika obustaviti ako ustanovi da više ne postoji opasnost iz stavka 1. ovoga članka. Osuđenik može ponoviti prijedlog, ali ne prije proteka jedne godine od zadnjeg preispitivanja.  
(8) Sud će o presudi kojom je izrečena mjera iz stavka 1. ovoga članka obavijestiti tijelo nadležno za vođenje upisnika osoba koje obavljaju određene dužnosti ili djelatnosti.

(4) Po proteku polovine trajanja sigurnosne mjere izrečene na temelju stavka 1. ovoga članka sud može na prijedlog osuđenika obustaviti njezino izvršenje ako ustanovi da više ne postoji opasnost iz stavka 1. ovoga članka. Osuđenik može ponoviti prijedlog, ali ne prije proteka jedne godine od zadnjeg preispitivanja.  
(5) Zabrana upravljanja motornim vozilom može se izreći doživotno kada se s obzirom na ranija počiniteljeva teška kršenja prometnih propisa može očekivati da će i nakon proteka najdužeg vremena iz stavka 3. ovoga članka postojati opasnost da počinitelj ponovno počini kazneno djelo protiv sigurnosti prometa. Utvrdi li sud povodom prijedloga osuđenika da nakon proteka najdužeg vremena iz stavka 3. ovoga članka opasnost više ne postoji, ukinut će zabranu. (6) Na zabranu upravljanja motornim vozilom shodno će se primijeniti odredba članka 71. stavka 5. ovoga Zakona.  
(7) Vrijeme privremenog oduzimanja vozačke dozvole uračunat će se u vrijeme zabrane upravljanja motornim vozilom.

## Article 71. (144/12, 56/15, 84/21)

(1) The security measure of prohibition of full or partial performance of a certain duty or activity shall be imposed by the court on a perpetrator who committed a criminal offense in the performance of a duty or activity if there is a danger that by abusing that duty or activity he will commit a criminal offense again.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment
(2) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed for a period of one to ten years. For a perpetrator who has been sentenced to imprisonment and has not been given a suspended sentence nor has the imprisonment been replaced by community service, the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed for a period that is one to ten years longer than the imposed imprisonment.  
(3) For a perpetrator of a criminal offense from Article 105 paragraph 3, Article 106 paragraphs 2 and 3, Article 111 point 2, Article 112 paragraph 1, Article 114, Article 116, Article 118, Article 119, Article 120, Chapter XVI, committed to the detriment of a child and Chapter XVII of this Act, the court shall impose a prohibition of performance of duties or activities in which he comes into regular contact with children even when these acts were not committed in the performance of duties and activities, if there is a danger that by abusing that duty or activity he will commit these criminal offenses again, and may impose it for life.  
(4) During the prohibition from paragraph 1 of this Article, the convicted person may not engage in a certain duty or activity independently, for another person, in a legal entity, nor on behalf of another person, nor may he authorize another person to engage in that duty or activity on his behalf and according to his instructions.  
(5) If the perpetrator does not comply with the prohibition of performance of a certain duty or activity when it has been imposed together with community service, a suspended sentence, or during conditional release, the provisions of Article 55 paragraph 9, Article 58 paragraph 5 or Article 61 paragraph 3 of this Act shall apply accordingly.  
(6) After the expiry of half the duration of the security measure imposed on the basis of paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may, at the proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it establishes that the danger from paragraph 1 of this Article no longer exists. The convicted person may repeat the proposal, but not before the expiry of one year from the last review.  
(7) After the expiry of the maximum time from paragraph 2 of this Article, the court may, at the proposal of the convicted person, suspend the security measure imposed on the basis of paragraph 3 of this Article if it establishes that the danger from paragraph 1 of this Article no longer exists. (8) The court shall notify the body competent for maintaining the register of persons performing certain duties or activities of the judgment imposing the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article.

Prohibition of driving a motor vehicle

## Article 72. (NN 56/15)

(1) The security measure of prohibition of driving a motor vehicle shall be imposed by the court on a perpetrator of a criminal offense against traffic safety when there is a danger that by driving a motor vehicle he will endanger traffic safety. The prohibition applies to all categories of vehicles, and exceptionally a certain category of vehicle may be excluded when special circumstances indicate that the purpose of the measure will not thereby be jeopardized.  
(2) If the conditions from paragraph 1 of this Article are met, the court shall impose a prohibition of driving a motor vehicle also on a person not accountable if his action indicates that he is incapable of driving.  
(3) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be determined for a period of one to five years. For a perpetrator who has been sentenced to imprisonment and has not been given a suspended sentence nor has the imprisonment been replaced by community service, the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed for a period that is one to five years longer than the imposed imprisonment.  
(4) After the expiry of half the duration of the security measure imposed on the basis of paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may, at the proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it establishes that the danger from paragraph 1 of this Article no longer exists. The convicted person may repeat the proposal, but not before the expiry of one year from the last review.  
(5) The prohibition of driving a motor vehicle may be imposed for life when, having regard to the perpetrator's previous serious violations of traffic regulations, it can be expected that even after the expiry of the maximum time from paragraph 3 of this Article there will be a danger that the perpetrator will commit a criminal offense against traffic safety again. If the court establishes, following the proposal of the convicted person, that after the expiry of the maximum time from paragraph 3 of this Article the danger no longer exists, it shall revoke the prohibition. The convicted person may repeat the proposal, but not before the expiry of one year from the last review. After the revocation of the prohibition, the perpetrator must take the driving test again.  
(6) The provision of Article 71 paragraph 5 of this Act shall apply accordingly to the prohibition of driving a motor vehicle.  
(7) The time of temporary withdrawal of the driving license shall be counted in the time of prohibition of driving a motor vehicle.  
(8) The court shall notify the police of the judgment imposing the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article.  
(9) The manner of execution of the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be prescribed by regulation by the minister competent for internal affairs.

(1) The security measure of prohibition of approaching, harassing or stalking a victim, another person or group of persons, or prohibition of approaching a certain place shall be imposed by the court on a perpetrator when there is a danger that the perpetrator could commit a criminal offense again towards those persons or at those places.  
(2) The measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed for a period of one to five years. For a perpetrator who has been sentenced to imprisonment and has not been given a suspended sentence nor has the imprisonment been replaced by community service, the measure from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed for a period that is one to five years longer than the imposed imprisonment.  
(3) After the expiry of half the duration of the security measure imposed on the basis of paragraph 1 of this Article, the court may, at the proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it establishes that the danger from paragraph 1 of this Article no longer exists. The convicted person may repeat the proposal, but not before the expiry of one year from the last review.

## Članak 76. (144/12, 56/15, 118/18, 84/21)

(1) Sigurnosnu mjeru zaštitnog nadzora po punom izvršenju kazne zatvora sud će izreći počinitelju ako mu je izrečena kazna zatvora u trajanju od pet ili više godina za namjerno kazneno djelo ili u trajanju od dvije ili više godina za namjerno kazneno djelo s obilježjem nasilja ili kazna zatvora za drugo kazneno djelo iz glave XVI. ili XVII. ovoga Zakona pod uvjetom da kazna bude u potpunosti izdržana jer osuđeniku nije odobren uvjetni otpust.

(3) Sud prilikom donošenja presude može odrediti da se zaštitni nadzor ne provodi ako ima razloga vjerovati da osoba neće ponovno počiniti kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka i bez njegova provođenja.  
(4) Vrijeme provjeravanja traje od jedne do tri godine, osim ako je kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinjeno na štetu djeteta, kada vrijeme provjeravanja traje od jedne do pet godina. ## Article 74. (144/12, 56/15, 84/21)

(1) The security measure of removal from the joint household shall be imposed by the court on the perpetrator of a criminal offense of violence against a person with whom they live in a joint household if there is a high degree of danger that without the implementation of this measure the perpetrator could commit violence again against a member of the joint household.  
(2) The measure from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed for a duration of three months to three years. For a perpetrator who has been sentenced to imprisonment, and has not been given a suspended sentence nor has the imprisonment been replaced by community service, the measure from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed for a duration that is three months to three years longer than the imposed imprisonment.  
(3) The person to whom the measure from paragraph 1. of this Article has been imposed is obliged, in the presence of a police officer, to immediately leave the apartment, house or other residential space that constitutes the joint household upon the finality of the judgment.  
(4) After half of the duration of the security measure of removal from the joint household imposed on the basis of paragraph 1. of this Article has elapsed, the court may, at the proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it determines that the danger from paragraph 1. of this Article no longer exists. The convicted person may repeat the proposal, but not before six months have elapsed from the last review.  
(5) The provision of Article 71. paragraph 5. of this Law shall apply mutatis mutandis to the measure of removal from the joint household.  
(6) The court shall notify the police of the judgment by which the measure from paragraph 1. of this Article has been imposed.  
Prohibition of access to the internet
(1) The security measure of prohibition of access to the internet shall be imposed by the court on a perpetrator who has committed a criminal offense via the internet if there is a danger that they will commit a criminal offense again by misusing the internet.  
(2) The measure from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed for a duration of six months to two years. For a perpetrator who has been sentenced to imprisonment, and has not been given a suspended sentence nor has the imprisonment been replaced by community service, the measure from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed for a duration that is six months to two years longer than the imposed imprisonment.  
(3) After half of the duration of the security measure imposed on the basis of paragraph 1. of this Article has elapsed, the court may, at the proposal of the convicted person, suspend its execution if it determines that the danger from paragraph 1. of this Article no longer exists. The convicted person may repeat the proposal, but not before one year has elapsed from the last review.  
(4) The provision of Article 71. paragraph 5. of this Law shall apply mutatis mutandis to the prohibition of access to the internet.  
(5) The court shall notify the regulatory body responsible for electronic communications of the final measure imposed, which shall ensure its implementation.  
Protective supervision after full service of imprisonment

## Article 76. (144/12, 56/15, 118/18, 84/21)

(1) The security measure of protective supervision after full service of imprisonment shall be imposed by the court on a perpetrator if they have been sentenced to imprisonment for a duration of five or more years for an intentional criminal offense or for a duration of two or more years for an intentional criminal offense with the characteristic of violence or imprisonment for another criminal offense from Chapter XVI. or XVII. of this Law provided that the sentence is fully served because the convicted person has not been granted conditional release.  
(2) Protective supervision shall begin to be implemented over the perpetrator immediately after release from prison in accordance with Article 64. of this Law and the special obligations from Article 62. paragraph 2. points 6. to 9. if they have been imposed together with protective supervision.  
(3) The court, when rendering the judgment, may determine that protective supervision shall not be implemented if there are reasons to believe that the person will not commit a criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article again even without its implementation.  
(4) The verification period lasts from one to three years, except when the criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article has been committed to the detriment of a child, when the verification period lasts from one to five years. The court may extend the verification period before its expiration, at the proposal of the competent probation authority, for another year if without the implementation of protective supervision there would be a danger of repeated commission of any of the criminal offenses specified in paragraph 1. of this Article.  
(5) The enforcement court shall, after the expiration of the first year from the beginning of the implementation of protective supervision and thereafter at least once annually, review the need for its continued implementation and render a decision thereon. At the proposal of the competent probation authority or the convicted person, this review may be conducted earlier, but not before six months have elapsed from the last review. The court may suspend the implementation of protective supervision if there are reasons to believe that the convicted person will not commit a criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article again even without its further implementation.  
Conditions and manner of confiscation of pecuniary gain

## Article 77

(1) Pecuniary gain shall be confiscated by a court decision by which it has been established that an unlawful act has been committed. Pecuniary gain shall also be confiscated from a person to whom it has been transferred if it was not acquired in good faith.

CASE LAW: JudgmentandDecision, Judgment
(3) The court shall confiscate pecuniary gain even if it refers the injured party to pursue the property claim in civil proceedings.  
(4) When the impossibility of confiscating things or rights obtained as pecuniary gain in whole or in part is established, the court shall order the perpetrator to pay the corresponding counter-value in a monetary amount. Payment may be determined in installments.

(6) The court may decide that pecuniary gain shall not be confiscated if it is negligible.

(3) Ako je imovinska korist od kaznenog djela sjedinjena s imovinom stečenom na zakonit način, ukupna imovina bit će predmetom oduzimanja do procijenjene vrijednosti imovinske koristi. Na isti način i u istom omjeru oduzet će se i korist koja je dobivena od imovine u koju je zakonita imovina sjedinjena s imovinskom korišću od kaznenog djela.  
(4) Imovinska korist iz stavka 2. i 3. ovoga članka oduzet će se od člana obitelji bez obzira po kojem pravnom temelju se kod njega nalazi i neovisno o tome živi li u zajedničkom kućanstvu s počiniteljem.  
(5) Imovinska korist iz stavka 2. i 3. ovoga članka oduzet će se i od druge osobe bez obzira po kojem pravnom temelju je stečena ako ta osoba ne učini vjerojatnim da je korist stekla u dobroj vjeri i po razumnoj cijeni.  
(6) Ako osoba protiv koje je pokrenut kazneni postupak umre, imovinska korist ostvarena protupravnom radnjom može se oduzeti od njezinih sljednika u postupku propisanom posebnim zakonom.

(2) Protupravna radnja je radnja kojom su ispunjena obilježja kaznenog djela, a ne postoji razlog isključenja protupravnosti.  
(3) Službena osoba je državni dužnosnik ili službenik, dužnosnik ili službenik u jedinici lokalne i područne (regionalne) samouprave, nositelj pravosudne dužnosti, sudac porotnik, član Državnog sudbenog vijeća ili Državnoodvjetničkog vijeća, arbitar, javni bilježnik i stručni radnik koji obavlja poslove iz djelatnosti socijalne skrbi, odgoja i obrazovanja. Službenom osobom smatra se i osoba koja u Europskoj uniji, stranoj državi, međunarodnoj organizaciji koje je Republika Hrvatska član, međunarodnom sudu ili arbitraži čiju sudbenost Republika Hrvatska prihvaća, obavlja dužnosti povjerene osobama iz prethodne rečenice.  
(4) Vojna osoba je djelatna vojna osoba, ročnik, pričuvnik i kadet te državni službenik i namještenik raspoređen na službu u Oružanim snagama Republike Hrvatske.  
(5) Kad je službena osoba naznačena kao počinitelj kaznenog djela koje nije predviđeno u Glavi XXXIV. ovoga Zakona, ili kao osoba prema kojoj je počinjeno kazneno djelo, službenom osobom smatrat će se i vojna osoba.  
(6) Odgovorna osoba je fizička osoba koja vodi poslove pravne osobe ili joj je izričito ili stvarno povjereno obavljanje poslova iz područja djelovanja pravne osobe ili državnih tijela ili tijela jedinice lokalne i područne (regionalne) samouprave.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda
(7) Dijete je osoba koja nije navršila osamnaest godina života.  
(8) Članovi obitelji su bračni ili izvanbračni drug, životni partner ili neformalni životni partner, njihova zajednička djeca te djeca svakog od njih, srodnik po krvi u ravnoj lozi, srodnik u pobočnoj lozi zaključno do trećeg stupnja, srodnici po tazbini do zaključno drugog stupnja, posvojitelj i posvojenik.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(9) Bliske osobe su članovi obitelji, bivši bračni ili izvanbračni drug bivši životni partner ili neformalni životni partner, sadašnji ili bivši partner u intimnoj vezi, osobe koje imaju zajedničko dijete i osobe koje žive u zajedničkom kućanstvu.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda
(10) Izvanbračni drug je osoba koja živi u izvanbračnoj zajednici koja ima trajniji karakter ili koja traje kraće vrijeme ako je u njoj rođeno zajedničko dijete.  
(11) Neformalni životni partner je osoba koja živi u istospolnoj zajednici koja ima trajniji karakter.  
(12) Tajni podatak je podatak koji je prema posebnom zakonu označen kao klasificirani podatak. Ne smatra se tajnim podatkom podatak čiji je sadržaj suprotan ustavnom poretku Republike Hrvatske ili podatak koji je označen tajnim radi prikrivanja kaznenog djela, prekoračenja ili zlouporabe ovlasti te drugih oblika nezakonitog postupanja u državnim tijelima.  
(13) Službena tajna je podatak koji je prikupljen i koristi se za potrebe tijela javne vlasti, a koji je zakonom, drugim propisom ili općim aktom nadležnog tijela donesenim na temelju zakona proglašen službenom tajnom.  
(14) Izbori su izbori za Hrvatski sabor, Predsjednika Republike, Europski parlament, predstavnička tijela u jedinicama lokalne i područne (regionalne) samouprave, općinske načelnike, gradonačelnike, župane, gradonačelnika Grada Zagreba te postupak odlučivanja na državnom referendumu.  
(15) Isprava je svaki predmet koji sadrži zapis, znak ili sliku koji je podoban ili određen da služi kao dokaz neke činjenice koja ima vrijednost za pravne odnose.  
(16) Pokretna stvar je i svaka proizvedena ili skupljena energija za davanje svjetlosti, topline ili kretanja, kao i telefonski impulsi.  
(17) Motorno vozilo je svako prometno sredstvo na motorni pogon u kopnenom, vodenom i zračnom prometu.  
(18) Računalni sustav je svaka naprava ili skupina međusobno spojenih ili povezanih naprava, od kojih jedna ili više njih na osnovi programa automatski obrađuju podatke, kao i računalni podaci koji su u njega spremljeni, obrađeni, učitani ili preneseni za svrhe njegovog rada, korištenja, zaštite i održavanja.  
(19) Računalni podatak je svako iskazivanje činjenica, informacija ili zamisli u obliku prikladnom za obradu u računalnom sustavu.  
(20) Računalni program je skup računalnih podataka koji su u stanju prouzročiti da računalni sustav izvrši određenu funkciju.  
(21) Zločin iz mržnje je kazneno djelo počinjeno zbog rasne pripadnosti, boje kože, vjeroispovijesti, nacionalnog ili etničkog podrijetla, jezika, invaliditeta, spola, spolnog opredjeljenja ili rodnog identiteta druge osobe. Takvo postupanje uzet će se kao otegotna okolnost ako ovim Zakonom nije izričito propisano teže kažnjavanje.  
Protokol o postupanju u slučaju zločina iz mržnje
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Odluka Ustavnog suda
(22) Imovinskom korišću od kaznenog djela smatra se neposredna imovinska korist ostvarena počinjenjem kaznenog djela, imovina u koju je promijenjena ili pretvorena neposredna imovinska korist od kaznenog djela, kao i svaka druga korist koja je ostvarena od neposredne imovinske koristi od kaznenog djela ili imovine u koju je promijenjena ili pretvorena neposredna imovinska korist od kaznenog djela bez obzira nalazi li se na području Republike Hrvatske ili izvan njega.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda
(23) Imovinom se smatra imovina bilo koje vrste, neovisno o tome je li materijalna ili nematerijalna, pokretna ili nepokretna, odnosno pravni dokumenti ili instrumenti kojima se dokazuje pravo na ili interes za takvu imovinu.  
(24) Mito je svaka nepripadna nagrada, dar ili druga imovinska ili neimovinska korist bez obzira na vrijednost.  
(25) Žrtva kaznenog djela je fizička osoba koja je pretrpjela fizičke i duševne posljedice, imovinsku štetu ili bitnu povredu temeljnih prava i sloboda koji su izravna posljedica kaznenog djela. Žrtvom kaznenog djela smatraju se i bračni i izvanbračni drug, životni partner ili neformalni životni partner te potomak, a ako njih nema, predak, brat i sestra one osobe čija je smrt izravno prouzročena kaznenim djelom te osoba koju je ona na temelju zakona bila dužna uzdržavati.  
(26) Riječi i pojmovni sklopovi koji imaju rodno značenje bez obzira na to jesu li u ovom Zakonu korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu odnose se na jednak način na muški i ženski rod.  
(27) Vrijednost imovine, imovinske štete, imovinske koristi, porezne obveze i državne potpore je velikih razmjera ako prelazi 79.633,69 eura. Razaranja prouzročena kaznenim djelima su velika ako prelaze 79.633,69 eura.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(28) Vrijednost imovine je većeg opsega ako prelazi 26.544,56 eura.  
(29) Vrijednost stvari, imovinskog prava i imovinske koristi je velika ako prelazi 7963,37 eura. Vrijednost imovinske koristi i štete je znatna ako prelazi 7963,37 eura.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Rješenje, Presuda, Presuda
(30) Vrijednost stvari, imovinskog prava i imovinske koristi je mala ako ne prelazi 132,72 eura.  
(31) Bezgotovinski instrument plaćanja je pokretna stvar, isprava i računalni podatak odnosno program, zaštićeni uređaj, predmet ili zapis ili njihova kombinacija, osim zakonskih sredstava plaćanja, koji jest ili nije u fizičkom obliku, a nositelju ili korisniku omogućuje, samostalno ili u vezi s postupkom, odnosno nizom postupaka, prijenos novca ili novčane vrijednosti i pomoću digitalnih sredstava razmjene. Digitalno sredstvo razmjene znači bilo kakav elektronički novac i virtualne valute.

## Article 87. (144/12, 101/17, 118/18, 126/19, 84/21, 114/22)

(1) The criminal legislation of the Republic of Croatia consists of provisions contained in this Act and other laws of the Republic of Croatia, which determine the prerequisites for punishability and sanctions that may be imposed on perpetrators of criminal offences.  
(2) An unlawful act is an act that fulfils the elements of a criminal offence and for which there is no ground for exclusion of unlawfulness.  
(3) An official person is a state official or civil servant, an official or civil servant in a unit of local and regional self-government, a holder of judicial office, a lay judge, a member of the State Judicial Council or the State Attorney's Council, an arbitrator, a public notary and a professional worker who performs tasks in the field of social welfare, upbringing and education. An official person is also considered to be a person who, in the European Union, a foreign state, an international organisation of which the Republic of Croatia is a member, an international court or arbitration whose jurisdiction the Republic of Croatia accepts, performs duties entrusted to persons from the previous sentence.  
(4) A military person is an active military person, a conscript, a reservist and a cadet, as well as a state civil servant and employee assigned to service in the Armed Forces of the Republic of Croatia.  
(5) When an official person is designated as the perpetrator of a criminal offence that is not provided for in Chapter XXXIV of this Act, or as a person against whom a criminal offence has been committed, a military person shall also be considered an official person.  
(6) A responsible person is a natural person who manages the affairs of a legal person or who has been expressly or actually entrusted with the performance of tasks from the field of activity of a legal person or state bodies or bodies of a unit of local and regional self-government.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment, Judgment
(7) A child is a person who has not reached eighteen years of age.  
(8) Family members are a spouse or extramarital partner, life partner or informal life partner, their common children and the children of each of them, a blood relative in the direct line, a relative in the collateral line up to and including the third degree, relatives by affinity up to and including the second degree, an adopter and an adoptee.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment
(9) Close persons are family members, a former spouse or extramarital partner, a former life partner or informal life partner, a current or former partner in an intimate relationship, persons who have a common child and persons who live in a common household.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment, Judgment
(10) An extramarital partner is a person who lives in an extramarital union that has a more permanent character or that lasts for a shorter time if a common child was born in it.  
(11) An informal life partner is a person who lives in a same-sex union that has a more permanent character.  
(12) A secret datum is a datum that is designated as classified data pursuant to a special law. A datum whose content is contrary to the constitutional order of the Republic of Croatia or a datum that is designated as secret for the purpose of concealing a criminal offence, exceeding or abusing authority and other forms of unlawful conduct in state bodies shall not be considered a secret datum.  
(13) An official secret is a datum that is collected and used for the needs of public authority bodies, and which has been declared an official secret by law, other regulation or general act of the competent body adopted on the basis of law.  
(14) Elections are elections for the Croatian Parliament, the President of the Republic, the European Parliament, representative bodies in units of local and regional self-government, municipal heads, mayors, county prefects, the Mayor of the City of Zagreb, as well as the decision-making procedure in a state referendum.  
(15) A document is any object that contains a record, sign or image that is suitable or intended to serve as proof of a fact that has value for legal relations.  
(16) A movable thing also includes any produced or collected energy for providing light, heat or motion, as well as telephone impulses.  
(17) A motor vehicle is any means of transport with motor propulsion in land, water and air traffic.  
(18) A computer system is any device or group of interconnected or linked devices, one or more of which, on the basis of a program, automatically process data, as well as computer data stored, processed, loaded or transmitted into it for the purposes of its operation, use, protection and maintenance.  
(19) Computer data is any representation of facts, information or ideas in a form suitable for processing in a computer system.  
(20) A computer program is a set of computer data that is capable of causing a computer system to perform a specific function.  
(21) A hate crime is a criminal offence committed because of the racial affiliation, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, language, disability, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity of another person. Such conduct shall be taken as an aggravating circumstance if more severe punishment is not expressly prescribed by this Act.  
Protocol on procedure in cases of hate crimes

(22) Pecuniary gain from a criminal offence is considered to be the direct pecuniary gain obtained by committing a criminal offence, property into which the direct pecuniary gain from the criminal offence has been changed or converted, as well as any other gain obtained from the direct pecuniary gain from the criminal offence or property into which the direct pecuniary gain from the criminal offence has been changed or converted, regardless of whether it is located in the territory of the Republic of Croatia or outside it.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment, Judgment
(23) Property means property of any kind, regardless of whether it is tangible or intangible, movable or immovable, or legal documents or instruments proving a right to or interest in such property.  
(24) A bribe is any undue reward, gift or other pecuniary or non-pecuniary benefit regardless of value.  
(25) A victim of a criminal offence is a natural person who has suffered physical and mental consequences, property damage or a substantial violation of fundamental rights and freedoms that are a direct consequence of a criminal offence. A victim of a criminal offence is also considered to be the spouse and extramarital partner, life partner or informal life partner and descendant, and if there are none, the ancestor, brother and sister of the person whose death was directly caused by the criminal offence, as well as a person whom that person was obliged to support on the basis of law.  
(26) Words and conceptual constructions that have gender significance, regardless of whether they are used in this Act in the masculine or feminine gender, refer equally to the masculine and feminine gender.

## Članak 88

(1) Tko s ciljem da potpuno ili djelomice uništi neku nacionalnu, etničku, rasnu ili vjersku skupinu kao takvu:
1. ubija članove skupine,
2. nanosi članovima skupine teške tjelesne ozljede ili im teško naruši zdravlje,
3. stavlja skupinu u životne uvjete kojima je cilj dovesti do njezina potpuna ili djelomična uništenja,
4. primjenjuje mjere kojima je cilj spriječiti rađanje unutar skupine, ili
5. prisilno preseljava djecu u drugu skupinu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora najmanje deset godina ili kaznom dugotrajnog zatvora.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko zapovijedi počinjenje genocida.  
(3) Tko izravno i javno potiče na počinjenje genocida,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
Zločin agresije

## Članak 89. (144/12)

(1) Tko imajući stvarnu moć nadzirati ili upravljati političkim ili vojnim djelovanjem države, upotrijebi oružane snage jedne države protiv suvereniteta, teritorijalne cjelovitosti ili političke neovisnosti druge države ili na bilo koji drugi način protivan Povelji Ujedinjenih naroda ostvari čin agresije koji po svojim karakteristikama, težini i razmjeru predstavlja očito kršenje Povelje Ujedinjenih naroda,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora najmanje pet godina ili kaznom dugotrajnog zatvora.  
(2) Tko sudjeluje u djelovanju oružanih snaga iz stavka 1. ovoga članka,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od tri do petnaest godina.  
(3) Tko izravno i javno potiče na zločin agresije,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(4) Činom agresije iz stavka 1. ovoga članka, bez obzira na to je li prethodno objavljen rat ili ne, smatra se:
1. invazija ili napad oružanih snaga jedne države na područje druge države, ili vojna okupacija, makar i privremena koja je posljedica takve invazije ili napada, ili pripajanje cijelog ili dijela područja druge države uz primjenu sile,
2. bombardiranje od strane oružanih snaga jedne države područja druge države ili korištenje bilo kakvog oružja jedne države na području druge države,
3. blokiranje luka ili obala jedne države oružanim snagama druge države,
4. napad oružanih snaga jedne države na kopnene, pomorske i zračne snage druge države,
5. korištenje oružanih snaga jedne države, koje su na području druge države uz njezinu suglasnost, u suprotnosti s uvjetima predviđenim njihovim sporazumom ili produljenje prisutnosti vojnih snaga na području druge države po prestanku sporazuma,
6. davanje dozvole da područje koje je država stavila na raspolaganje drugoj državi ova koristi za agresiju protiv treće države, ili
7. slanje od strane ili u ime države naoružanih bandi, grupa, paravojnih snaga ili plaćenika koji izvode oružane akcije protiv druge države koje po svojoj težini odgovaraju prethodno navedenim radnjama ili njezino značajno sudjelovanje u takvim akcijama.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
Zločin protiv čovječnosti

## Članak 90. (144/12)

(1) Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnog prava u sklopu širokog ili sustavnog napada usmjerenog protiv civilnog stanovništva, uz znanje o tom napadu:
1. ubije drugu osobu,
2. radi istrebljenja nametne nekom civilnom stanovništvu životne uvjete kojima je cilj dovesti do njegova djelomičnog uništenja,
3. stavi u ropstvo neku osobu tako da nad njom vrši pojedine ili sve ovlasti koje proizlaze iz prava vlasništva, uključujući vršenje takvih ovlasti u trgovini ljudima,
4. protjeruje ili prisilno premješta druge osobe putem izgona ili drugih prisilnih mjera s područja na kome zakonito borave, a bez osnova predviđenih međunarodnim pravom,
5. protupravno zatvori drugu osobu ili joj na drugi način protupravno oduzme slobodu,
6. muči osobu kojoj je oduzeta sloboda ili je pod nadzorom okrivljenika tako da joj namjerno nanosi teške tjelesne ili duševne boli ili patnje, osim onih koje proizlaze, svojstvene su ili su slučajna posljedica zakonite kazne,
7. siluje drugu osobu, drži je u spolnom ropstvu, prisiljava na prostituciju, nezakonito drži u zatočenju ženu koja je nasilno zatrudnjela kako bi se utjecalo na etnički sastav nekog stanovništva ili činile kakve druge teške povrede međunarodnog prava, drugoj osobi bez njezina pristanka i kada to nije opravdano medicinskim razlozima oduzme biološku reproduktivnu sposobnost ili nad njom izvrši neko drugo spolno nasilje usporedive težine,
8. progoni neku odredivu skupinu ili zajednicu na političkoj, rasnoj, nacionalnoj, etničkoj, kulturnoj, vjerskoj, spolnoj ili drugoj osnovi koja se općenito prema međunarodnom pravu smatra nedopustivom, i to počini u vezi s bilo kojom radnjom opisanom u članku 88. do 91. ovoga Zakona tako da drugoj osobi zato što pripada određenoj skupini ili zajednici namjerno i u velikoj mjeri oduzme temeljna prava suprotno međunarodnom pravu,
9. uhiti, drži u zatočeništvu ili otme osobe u ime ili uz dopuštenje, potporu ili pristanak države ili političke organizacije, a nakon toga odbije priznati takvo oduzimanje slobode ili uskrati obavijesti o sudbini ili mjestu na kojem se osobe nalaze, s ciljem da im se uskrati pravna zaštita kroz dulje vremensko razdoblje,
10. u okviru institucionaliziranog režima sustavnog potlačivanja i dominacije jedne rasne skupine nad drugom rasnom skupinom ili skupinama i u namjeri održavanja takvog režima počini neko nečovječno djelo opisano u ovom članku ili djelo slično nekom od tih djela (zločin apartheida), ili
11. počini druga nečovječna djela kojima se namjerno uzrokuje teška patnja, teška tjelesna ozljeda ili teško narušenje zdravlja,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora najmanje pet godina ili kaznom dugotrajnog zatvora.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko zapovijedi neko od navedenih kaznenih djela.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Rješenje, Rješenje
Ratni zločin
