## Article 88

(1) Whoever, with the aim of destroying, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial or religious group as such:
1. kills members of the group,
2. causes serious bodily injury to members of the group or seriously impairs their health,
3. places the group in living conditions aimed at bringing about its complete or partial destruction,
4. applies measures aimed at preventing births within the group, or
5. forcibly transfers children to another group,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least ten years or by long-term imprisonment.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever orders the commission of genocide.  
(3) Whoever directly and publicly incites the commission of genocide,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
Crime of aggression

## Article 89. (144/12)

(1) Whoever, having actual power to control or direct the political or military action of a State, uses the armed forces of one State against the sovereignty, territorial integrity or political independence of another State or in any other manner contrary to the Charter of the United Nations commits an act of aggression which by its character, gravity and scale constitutes a manifest violation of the Charter of the United Nations,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least five years or by long-term imprisonment.  
(2) Whoever participates in the action of armed forces from paragraph 1 of this Article,
shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
(3) Whoever directly and publicly incites the crime of aggression,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(4) An act of aggression from paragraph 1 of this Article, regardless of whether war has been previously declared or not, shall be considered:
1. invasion or attack by the armed forces of one State on the territory of another State, or military occupation, even if temporary, resulting from such invasion or attack, or annexation of the whole or part of the territory of another State by the use of force,
2. bombardment by the armed forces of one State of the territory of another State or the use of any weapons by one State against the territory of another State,
3. blockade of ports or coasts of one State by the armed forces of another State,
4. attack by the armed forces of one State on the land, sea and air forces of another State,
5. use of the armed forces of one State, which are on the territory of another State with its consent, contrary to the conditions provided for in their agreement, or extension of the presence of military forces on the territory of another State after the termination of the agreement,
6. granting permission for territory which a State has placed at the disposal of another State to be used by that State for aggression against a third State, or
7. sending by or on behalf of a State of armed bands, groups, paramilitary forces or mercenaries which carry out armed actions against another State of such gravity as to correspond to the acts listed above, or its substantial involvement in such actions.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
Crime against humanity

## Article 90. (144/12)

(1) Whoever, in violation of the rules of international law, as part of a widespread or systematic attack directed against a civilian population, with knowledge of that attack:
1. kills another person,
2. for the purpose of extermination, imposes on a civilian population living conditions aimed at bringing about its partial destruction,
3. enslaves a person by exercising over that person any or all of the powers attaching to the right of ownership, including the exercise of such powers in trafficking in persons,
4. deports or forcibly transfers other persons by expulsion or other coercive measures from the area where they lawfully reside, without grounds provided for by international law,
5. unlawfully imprisons another person or otherwise unlawfully deprives them of liberty,
6. tortures a person deprived of liberty or under the control of the accused by intentionally inflicting severe physical or mental pain or suffering, other than that arising from, inherent in or incidental to lawful punishment,
7. rapes another person, holds them in sexual slavery, forces them into prostitution, unlawfully holds in captivity a woman who has been forcibly impregnated in order to affect the ethnic composition of a population or commits any other serious violation of international law, deprives another person without their consent and when not justified by medical reasons of biological reproductive capacity or commits against them any other sexual violence of comparable gravity,
8. persecutes an identifiable group or community on political, racial, national, ethnic, cultural, religious, gender or other grounds that are universally considered impermissible under international law, and does so in connection with any act described in Articles 88 to 91 of this Act by intentionally and severely depriving another person of fundamental rights contrary to international law because they belong to a particular group or community,
9. arrests, holds in captivity or abducts persons in the name of or with the permission, support or consent of a State or political organization, and thereafter refuses to acknowledge such deprivation of liberty or withholds information about the fate or whereabouts of the persons, with the aim of denying them legal protection for a prolonged period of time,
10. within the framework of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and domination of one racial group over another racial group or groups and with the intention of maintaining such a regime, commits an inhumane act described in this Article or an act similar to any of those acts (crime of apartheid), or
11. commits other inhumane acts intentionally causing severe suffering, serious bodily injury or serious impairment of health,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least five years or by long-term imprisonment.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever orders any of the specified criminal offences.

## Članak 91. (144/12, 56/15, 84/21)

(1) Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnog prava za vrijeme rata, okupacije ili međunarodnog oružanog sukoba ili oružanog sukoba koji nema međunarodni značaj počini neko od sljedećih teških kršenja protiv osoba ili imovine zaštićenih Ženevskim konvencijama od 12. kolovoza 1949.:
1. ubojstvo,
2. mučenje ili nečovječno postupanje, uključujući biološke pokuse,
3. nanošenje velike patnje, teške tjelesne ozljede ili teškog narušenja zdravlja,
4. nezakonito protjerivanje, premještaj ili nezakonito držanje zaštićene osobe u zatočeništvu,
5. prisiljavanje ratnog zarobljenika ili druge zaštićene osobe na službu u postrojbama neprijateljske sile,
6. uskraćivanje prava ratnom zarobljeniku ili drugoj zaštićenoj osobi na pravičan i redovan postupak,
7. uzimanje talaca, ili
8. opsežno uništavanje i oduzimanje imovine koje nije opravdano vojnom nuždom i koje je provedeno nezakonito i samovoljno,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od najmanje pet godina ili kaznom dugotrajnog zatvora.  
(2) Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnog prava za vrijeme rata, okupacije ili međunarodnog oružanog sukoba ili oružanog sukoba koji nema međunarodni značaj počini druge teške povrede prava i običaja koji se primjenjuju u međunarodnom oružanom sukobu ili oružanom sukobu čiji značaj nije međunarodni, to jest bilo koje od sljedećih djela:
1. usmjeravanje napada protiv civilnog stanovništva ili protiv pojedinih civila koji ne sudjeluju izravno u neprijateljstvima,
2. usmjeravanje napada protiv civilnih objekata, odnosno objekata koji nisu vojni ciljevi,
3. usmjeravanje napada protiv osoblja, uređaja, materijala, jedinica ili vozila uključenih u humanitarnu pomoć ili misiju održavanja mira sukladno Povelji Ujedinjenih naroda, tako dugo dok oni imaju pravo na zaštitu civila ili civilnih objekata prema odredbama međunarodnog ratnog prava,
4. pokretanje napada sa znanjem da će takav napad uzgredno dovesti do smrti ili ozljeda civila ili štete na civilnim objektima ili do teške, dugoročne i opsežne štete u prirodnom okolišu koja bi očito bila nerazmjerna u odnosu na očekivani konkretan i izravan vojni dobitak,
5. napadanje ili bombardiranje, bilo kojim sredstvima, gradova, sela, naselja ili zgrada koje su nebranjene i ne predstavljaju vojne ciljeve,
6. ubijanje ili ranjavanje borca koji se predao, nakon što je položio oružje ili ostao bez sredstava za borbu,
7. nepravilna uporaba zastave primirja, zastave ili vojnog znakovlja i odore neprijatelja ili Ujedinjenih naroda, kao i posebnih znakova Ženevskih konvencija, zbog koje je došlo do pogibije ili teških ozljeda,
8. premještanje, izravno ili posredno, dijelova vlastitog civilnog stanovništva na okupirano područje od strane okupatorske sile, ili deportacija ili premještaj čitavog stanovništva okupiranog područja ili jednog njegovog dijela, unutar toga područja ili izvan njega,
9. usmjeravanje napada protiv zgrada posvećenih vjeri, obrazovanju, umjetnosti, znanosti ili humanitarnim svrhama, protiv povijesnih spomenika i kulturnih dobara, bolnica i mjesta na kojima se prikupljaju bolesni i ranjeni, pod uvjetom da nisu vojni ciljevi,
10. podvrgavanje osoba koje su u vlasti protivničke strane tjelesnom sakaćenju, uzimanju tkiva ili organa za transplantaciju ili medicinskim ili znanstvenim pokusima bilo koje vrste koji nisu opravdani medicinskim, zubarskim ili bolničkim tretmanom osoba o kojima je riječ te koji se ne izvode u njihovom interesu, a dovode do smrti ili ozbiljne opasnosti po zdravlje takve osobe ili osoba,
11. podmuklo ubijanje ili ranjavanje pripadnika neprijateljske nacije ili vojske,
12. proglašavanje da se protivniku neće dati nikakva milost,
13. uništavanje ili oduzimanje neprijateljske imovine osim ako to izričito zahtijeva ratna nužda,
14. proglašenje prava i radnji državljana neprijateljske strane zabranjenim, suspendiranim ili nedopuštenim u sudskom postupku,
15. prisiljavanje državljana neprijateljske strane da sudjeluju u ratnim operacijama usmjerenim protiv vlastite zemlje čak i ako su bili u službi zaraćene strane prije početka rata,
16. pljačkanje gradova ili mjesta,
17. uporaba otrova ili otrovnog oružja,
18. uporaba otrovnih plinova, plinova zagušljivaca ili drugih plinova te svih sličnih tekućina, tvari ili naprava,
19. uporaba oružja koje koristi mikrobiološke ili druge biološke agense ili otrove, bez obzira na njihovo podrijetlo ili način proizvodnje,
20. uporaba metaka koji se u ljudskom tijelu lako šire ili raspršuju,
21. uporaba oružja namijenjenog ranjavanju fragmentima koji se u ljudskom tijelu ne mogu otkriti rendgenskim zrakama,
22. uporaba posebno izrađenog laserskog oružja kojem je jedina ili jedna od namjena uzrokovanje trajnog sljepila,
23. uporaba oružja, projektila, materijala i načina ratovanja koji po svojoj prirodi nanose suvišne ozljede ili nepotrebne patnje ili kojima je svojstvo da protivno međunarodnom ratnom pravu ne razlikuju vojne i civilne ciljeve, ako je takvo oružje, projektili, materijal ili način ratovanja predmet sveobuhvatne zabrane,
24. skrnavljenje osobnog dostojanstva, posebice ponižavajući i degradirajući postupci, kolektivno kažnjavanje,
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
25. silovanje, spolno porobljavanje, prisiljavanje na prostituciju, trudnoću, sterilizaciju ili koji drugi oblik spolnog nasilja koji predstavlja tešku povredu Ženevskih konvencija,
26. iskorištavanje prisutnosti civila ili drugih zaštićenih osoba da se određena mjesta, područja ili vojne snage zaštite od vojnih operacija,
27. usmjeravanje napada na zgrade, materijal, medicinske jedinice i prijevozna sredstva te osoblje koje koristi posebne znakove Ženevskih konvencija sukladno međunarodnom pravu,
28. pribjegavanje izgladnjivanju civila kao načinu vođenja rata uskraćivanjem sredstava nužnih za opstanak, uključujući i otežavanje pristupa humanitarnoj pomoći, propisanoga Ženevskim konvencijama,
29. novačenje djece u nacionalne oružane snage ili oružane skupine odvojene od oružanih snaga države ili njihovo korištenje u aktivnom sudjelovanju u neprijateljstvima, ili
30. premještanje civilnog stanovništva zbog razloga povezanih uz sukob osim ako to traži sigurnost civila ili neizbježni vojni razlog,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora najmanje tri godine.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko djelo iz stavka 2. ovoga članka počini prema velikom broju ljudi ili na osobito okrutan ili podmukao način, iz koristoljublja ili drugih niskih pobuda.  
(4) Tko zapovijedi da se počini djelo iz stavka 1., 2. ili 3. ovoga članka kaznit će se kao da ga je sam počinio.  
Povreda pregovarača

## Članak 92

Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnoga prava za vrijeme rata ili oružanoga sukoba vrijeđa, zlostavlja ili zadrži pregovarača ili njegovu pratnju ili im spriječi povratak, ili na drugi način povrijedi njihovu nepovredivost,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
Zlouporaba međunarodnih znakova

## Članak 93

Tko u području oružanih operacija zlouporabi ili neovlašteno nosi zastavu ili znak Ujedinjenih naroda, Crvenog križa ili znakove koji njima odgovaraju, ili druge priznate međunarodne znakove kojima se obilježavaju određeni objekti radi zaštite od oružanih operacija,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
Neopravdana odgoda povratka ratnih zarobljenika

## Članak 94

Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnoga prava, nakon završetka rata ili oružanoga sukoba naredi ili izvrši neopravdanu odgodu povratka ratnih zarobljenika ili civilnih osoba,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.

## Article 91 (144/12, 56/15, 84/21)

(1) Whoever, in violation of the rules of international law during war, occupation or international armed conflict or armed conflict not of an international character, commits any of the following grave breaches against persons or property protected by the Geneva Conventions of 12 August 1949:
1. murder,
2. torture or inhuman treatment, including biological experiments,
3. inflicting great suffering, serious bodily injury or serious impairment of health,
4. unlawful deportation, transfer or unlawful detention of a protected person in captivity,
5. compelling a prisoner of war or other protected person to serve in the forces of a hostile power,
6. denying a prisoner of war or other protected person the right to a fair and regular trial,
7. taking of hostages, or
8. extensive destruction and appropriation of property not justified by military necessity and carried out unlawfully and arbitrarily,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least five years or by long-term imprisonment.  
(2) Whoever, in violation of the rules of international law during war, occupation or international armed conflict or armed conflict not of an international character, commits other serious violations of the laws and customs applicable in international armed conflict or armed conflict not of an international character, that is, any of the following acts:
1. directing attacks against the civilian population or against individual civilians not taking direct part in hostilities,
2. directing attacks against civilian objects, that is, objects which are not military objectives,
3. directing attacks against personnel, installations, material, units or vehicles involved in a humanitarian assistance or peacekeeping mission in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations, as long as they are entitled to the protection given to civilians or civilian objects under the provisions of international law of war,
4. launching an attack in the knowledge that such attack will incidentally cause loss of life or injury to civilians or damage to civilian objects or cause severe, long-term and widespread damage to the natural environment which would be clearly excessive in relation to the concrete and direct military advantage anticipated,
5. attacking or bombarding, by any means, towns, villages, dwellings or buildings which are undefended and do not constitute military objectives,
6. killing or wounding a combatant who has surrendered, after laying down arms or being left without means of combat,
7. improper use of a flag of truce, flag or military insignia and uniform of the enemy or the United Nations, as well as the distinctive signs of the Geneva Conventions, resulting in death or serious injury,
8. the transfer, directly or indirectly, of parts of its own civilian population into the territory it occupies by the occupying power, or the deportation or transfer of all or part of the population of the occupied territory within or outside that territory,
9. directing attacks against buildings dedicated to religion, education, art, science or charitable purposes, against historic monuments and cultural property, hospitals and places where the sick and wounded are collected, provided they are not military objectives,
10. subjecting persons who are in the power of an adverse party to physical mutilation, removal of tissue or organs for transplantation or to medical or scientific experiments of any kind which are not justified by the medical, dental or hospital treatment of the person concerned and which are not carried out in their interest, and which cause death or seriously endanger the health of such person or persons,
11. treacherously killing or wounding members of the hostile nation or army,
12. declaring that no quarter will be given to the adversary,
13. destroying or seizing enemy property unless such destruction or seizure is imperatively demanded by the necessities of war,
14. declaring the rights and actions of nationals of the hostile party to be abolished, suspended or inadmissible in judicial proceedings,
15. compelling nationals of the hostile party to take part in the operations of war directed against their own country even if they were in the service of the belligerent party before the commencement of the war,
16. pillaging a town or place,
17. employing poison or poisoned weapons,
18. employing poisonous gases, asphyxiating gases or other gases and all analogous liquids, materials or devices,
19. employing weapons which use microbiological or other biological agents or toxins, whatever their origin or method of production,
20. employing bullets which expand or flatten easily in the human body,
21. employing weapons intended to injure by fragments which are not detectable in the human body by X-rays,
22. employing specially designed laser weapons the sole or one of whose purposes is to cause permanent blindness,
23. employing weapons, projectiles, material and methods of warfare which are of a nature to cause superfluous injury or unnecessary suffering or which are inherently indiscriminate in violation of international law of war, provided that such weapons, projectiles, material or methods of warfare are the subject of a comprehensive prohibition,
24. outrages upon personal dignity, in particular humiliating and degrading treatment, collective punishment,
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment
25. rape, sexual slavery, enforced prostitution, pregnancy, sterilization or any other form of sexual violence constituting a grave breach of the Geneva Conventions,
26. utilizing the presence of civilians or other protected persons to render certain places, areas or military forces immune from military operations,
27. directing attacks against buildings, material, medical units and transport and personnel using the distinctive emblems of the Geneva Conventions in conformity with international law,
28. resorting to starvation of civilians as a method of warfare by depriving them of objects indispensable to their survival, including by impeding relief supplies as provided for under the Geneva Conventions,
29. conscripting children into the national armed forces or armed groups separate from the armed forces of the state or using them to participate actively in hostilities, or
30. ordering the displacement of the civilian population for reasons related to the conflict unless the security of the civilians involved or imperative military reasons so demand,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least three years.  
(3) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever commits the act from paragraph 2 of this Article against a large number of people or in a particularly cruel or treacherous manner, out of greed or other base motives.  
(4) Whoever orders the commission of an act from paragraph 1, 2 or 3 of this Article shall be punished as if he had committed it himself.  
Violation of negotiators

## Article 92

Whoever, in violation of the rules of international law during war or armed conflict, insults, mistreats or detains a negotiator or his escort or prevents their return, or otherwise violates their inviolability,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Misuse of international signs

## Article 93

Whoever in the area of armed operations misuses or wears without authorization the flag or sign of the United Nations, the Red Cross or signs corresponding to them, or other recognized international signs used to mark certain objects for protection from armed operations,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Unjustified delay in repatriation of prisoners of war

## Article 94

Whoever, in violation of the rules of international law, after the end of war or armed conflict, orders or carries out an unjustified delay in the repatriation of prisoners of war or civilian persons,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.

## Članak 95

(1) Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnoga prava novači, koristi, plaća ili osposobljava plaćenika za sudjelovanje u oružanom sukobu ili zajedničkom činu nasilja usmjerenom na rušenje vlade, podrivanje teritorijalne cjelovitosti države ili ugrožavanje njezina ustavnog ustrojstva,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(2) Tko novači dijete u oružane snage ili oružane skupine odvojene od oružanih snaga, ili tako unovačeno dijete koristi u neposrednim neprijateljskim djelovanjima,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(3) Tko radi stjecanja materijalne koristi kao punoljetni plaćenik izravno sudjeluje u oružanom sukobu ili zajedničkom činu nasilja,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
Odgovornost zapovjednika

## Članak 96

(1) Vojni zapovjednik ili nadređena civilna osoba ili osoba koja stvarno djeluje kao vojni zapovjednik ili nadređena civilna osoba koja ne spriječi osobu koja se nalazi pod njezinim stvarnim zapovjedništvom i nadzorom ili stvarnom vlašću i nadzorom da počini kazneno djelo iz članka 88. do 91. ovoga Zakona kaznit će se kao da ga je sama počinila. U tom slučaju neće se primijeniti odredba članka 20. stavka 3. ovoga Zakona.  
(2) Vojni zapovjednik ili osoba koja stvarno djeluje kao vojni zapovjednik koja je propustila dužni nadzor nad snagama koje se nalaze pod njezinim stvarnim zapovjedništvom i nadzorom ili stvarnom vlašću i nadzorom ako je morala znati da njezine snage čine ili se spremaju počiniti kazneno djelo iz članka 88. do članka 91. ovoga Zakona i nije poduzela sve nužne i razborite mjere u svojoj moći kako bi ih u tome spriječila,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od tri do petnaest godina.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 2. ovoga članka kaznit će se nadređena osoba, kod svih drugih odnosa nadređenosti i podređenosti osim onih iz stavka 2. ovoga članka, koja je propustila dužni nadzor nad podređenima koji se nalaze pod njezinom stvarnom vlašću i nadzorom ako je svjesno zanemarivala obavijesti da oni čine ili se spremaju počiniti kazneno djelo iz članka 88. do članka 91. ovoga Zakona i ako su ta djela u okviru njezinih stvarnih ovlasti i nadzora, a ona nije poduzela sve nužne i razborite mjere u svojoj moći kako bi ih u tome spriječila.  
(4) Ako je dužni nadzor iz stavka 2. i 3. ovoga članka propušten iz nehaja, počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(5) Osobe navedene u stavku 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka koje ne proslijede saznanja o kaznenim djelima iz članka 88. do članka 91. ovoga Zakona nadležnim vlastima u cilju provođenja istrage i kaznenog progona nad neposrednim počiniteljima koji su im podređeni,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
Terorizam

## Članak 97. (144/12, 118/18, 84/21)

(1) Tko s ciljem ozbiljnog zastrašivanja stanovništva, ili prisiljavanja države ili međunarodne organizacije da što učini ili ne učini, ili ozbiljnog narušavanja ili uništavanja temeljnih ustavnih, političkih, gospodarskih ili društvenih struktura države ili međunarodne organizacije, počini jedno od sljedećih djela koje može ozbiljno naštetiti državi ili međunarodnoj organizaciji:
1. napade na život osobe koji mogu prouzročiti smrt,
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
2. napade na tijelo drugoga,
3. otmicu ili uzimanje talaca,
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
4. uništenje državnih ili javnih objekata, prometnog sustava, infrastrukture uključujući i informacijske sustave, nepokretne platforme na epikontinentalnom pojasu, javnog mjesta ili privatne imovine koje može ugroziti živote ljudi ili prouzročiti znatnu gospodarsku štetu,
5. otmicu zrakoplova, broda ili drugih sredstava javnog prijevoza ili prijevoza robe,
6. izrada, posjedovanje, pribavljanje, prijevoz, opskrba ili uporaba oružja, eksploziva, nuklearnog, radiološkog, biološkog ili kemijskog oružja, kao i istraživanje i razvoj nuklearnog, radiološkog, biološkog ili kemijskog oružja,
7. ispuštanje opasnih tvari ili prouzročenje požara, eksplozija ili poplava, čime se ugrožava život ljudi,
8. ometanje ili obustava opskrbe vodom, električnom energijom ili drugim osnovnim prirodnim resursom, čime se ugrožava život ljudi, ili
9. posjeduje ili koristi radioaktivne tvari ili izrađuje, posjeduje ili koristi uređaj za aktiviranje, raspršivanje ili emitiranje radioaktivnog materijala ili ionizirajućeg zračenja, koristi ili ošteti nuklearni objekt tako da dođe do ispuštanja ili opasnosti od ispuštanja radioaktivnog materijala, ili upotrebom sile ili prijetnje zahtijeva radioaktivni materijal, uređaj za aktiviranje, raspršivanje ili emitiranje radioaktivnog materijala ili nuklearni objekt,
10. ometanje rada računalnog sustava kada je značajan broj računalnih sustava pogođen uporabom naprava namijenjenih ili prilagođenih za tu svrhu ili kada je time prouzročena znatna šteta ili kada je počinjeno u odnosu na računalni sustav kritične infrastrukture ili oštećenje računalnih podataka kada je počinjeno u odnosu na računalni sustav kritične infrastrukture,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od tri do petnaest godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(2) Tko prijeti počinjenjem kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
(3) Ako su kaznenim djelom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka prouzročena velika razaranja ili je prouzročena smrt jedne ili više osoba,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora najmanje pet godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(4) Ako počinitelj prigodom počinjenja kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka s namjerom usmrti jednu ili više osoba,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora najmanje deset godina ili kaznom dugotrajnog zatvora.  
Financiranje terorizma

## Članak 98. (NN 118/18, 126/19)

(1) Tko izravno ili neizravno daje ili prikuplja sredstva s ciljem da se ona koriste ili znajući da će se koristiti, u potpunosti ili djelomično, u svrhu činjenja ili doprinosa u činjenju jednog ili više kaznenih djela iz članka 97., članka 99. do članka 103. ili činjenja jednog ili više kaznenih djela iz članka 137., članka 216. stavka 1. do 3., članka 219., članka 223., članka 224., članka 352. do članka 355. ovoga Zakona ili drugog kaznenog djela kojem je cilj prouzročiti smrt ili tešku tjelesnu ozljedu civila ili druge osobe koja nije aktivno uključena u oružani sukob, ako je svrha tog djela zastrašiti stanovništvo ili prisiliti neku državu ili međunarodnu organizaciju da što učini ili ne učini,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko izravno ili neizravno daje ili prikuplja sredstva s ciljem da se ona koriste ili znajući da će se koristiti, u potpunosti ili djelomično od strane terorista ili terorističkog udruženja.  
(3) Sredstva iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka će se oduzeti.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
Javno poticanje na terorizam

## Članak 99

Tko javno iznese ili pronese zamisli kojima se izravno ili neizravno potiče na počinjenje kaznenog djela iz članka 97., članka 98., članka 137., članka 216. stavka 1. do 3., članka 219., članka 223., članka 224., članka 352. do članka 355. ovoga Zakona,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
Novačenje za terorizam

## Članak 100. (NN 118/18)

Tko vrbuje drugoga da se pridruži terorističkom udruženju radi počinjenja ili njegovog doprinosa u počinjenju kaznenog djela iz članka 97. ili počinjenja kaznenog djela iz članka 102., članka 137., članka 216. stavka 1. do 3., članka 219., članka 223., članka 224., članka 352. do članka 355. ovoga Zakona,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.

## Article 95

(1) Whoever, in violation of the rules of international law, recruits, uses, pays or trains a mercenary to participate in an armed conflict or a joint act of violence directed at overthrowing a government, undermining the territorial integrity of a state or endangering its constitutional order,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) Whoever recruits a child into armed forces or armed groups separate from the armed forces, or uses such a recruited child in direct hostile actions,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(3) Whoever, for the purpose of acquiring material gain, as an adult mercenary directly participates in an armed conflict or a joint act of violence,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
Responsibility of commanders

## Article 96

(1) A military commander or superior civilian person or a person actually acting as a military commander or superior civilian person who fails to prevent a person under their actual command and control or actual authority and control from committing a criminal offence under Articles 88 to 91 of this Act shall be punished as if they had committed it themselves. In that case, the provision of Article 20, paragraph 3 of this Act shall not apply.  
(2) A military commander or a person actually acting as a military commander who has failed to exercise due supervision over forces under their actual command and control or actual authority and control if they should have known that their forces are committing or are preparing to commit a criminal offence under Articles 88 to 91 of this Act and did not take all necessary and reasonable measures within their power to prevent them from doing so,
shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
(3) The penalty under paragraph 2 of this Article shall be imposed on a superior person, in all other superior-subordinate relationships except those under paragraph 2 of this Article, who has failed to exercise due supervision over subordinates under their actual authority and control if they consciously disregarded information that they are committing or are preparing to commit a criminal offence under Articles 88 to 91 of this Act and if those acts are within the scope of their actual authority and control, and they did not take all necessary and reasonable measures within their power to prevent them from doing so.  
(4) If the due supervision under paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article was omitted through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(5) The persons referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article who fail to forward information about criminal offences under Articles 88 to 91 of this Act to the competent authorities for the purpose of conducting an investigation and criminal prosecution of the direct perpetrators who are their subordinates,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Terrorism

## Article 97. (144/12, 118/18, 84/21)

(1) Whoever, with the aim of seriously intimidating the population, or compelling a state or international organisation to do or refrain from doing something, or seriously disrupting or destroying the fundamental constitutional, political, economic or social structures of a state or international organisation, commits one of the following acts which may seriously harm a state or international organisation:
1. attacks on the life of a person which may cause death,
CASE LAW: Decision
2. attacks on the body of another,
3. kidnapping or hostage-taking,
CASE LAW: Decision
4. destruction of state or public facilities, transport systems, infrastructure including information systems, fixed platforms on the continental shelf, public places or private property which may endanger human lives or cause substantial economic damage,
5. hijacking of aircraft, ships or other means of public transport or transport of goods,
6. manufacture, possession, acquisition, transport, supply or use of weapons, explosives, nuclear, radiological, biological or chemical weapons, as well as research and development of nuclear, radiological, biological or chemical weapons,
7. release of dangerous substances or causing fires, explosions or floods, thereby endangering human lives,
8. interference with or interruption of the supply of water, electricity or other basic natural resources, thereby endangering human lives, or
9. possesses or uses radioactive materials or manufactures, possesses or uses a device for activating, dispersing or emitting radioactive material or ionising radiation, uses or damages a nuclear facility in such a way as to cause the release or danger of release of radioactive material, or by use of force or threat demands radioactive material, a device for activating, dispersing or emitting radioactive material or a nuclear facility,
10. interference with the operation of a computer system when a significant number of computer systems are affected by the use of devices intended or adapted for that purpose or when substantial damage is thereby caused or when committed in relation to a computer system of critical infrastructure or damage to computer data when committed in relation to a computer system of critical infrastructure,
shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
CASE LAW: Decision
(2) Whoever threatens to commit a criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
(3) If the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article has caused major destruction or has caused the death of one or more persons,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment of at least five years.  
CASE LAW: Decision
(4) If the perpetrator, on the occasion of committing the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article, intentionally kills one or more persons,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least ten years or by long-term imprisonment.  
Financing of terrorism

## Article 98. (NN 118/18, 126/19)

(1) Whoever directly or indirectly provides or collects funds with the aim that they be used or knowing that they will be used, in whole or in part, for the purpose of committing or contributing to the commission of one or more criminal offences under Article 97, Articles 99 to 103 or committing one or more criminal offences under Article 137, Article 216 paragraphs 1 to 3, Article 219, Article 223, Article 224, Articles 352 to 355 of this Act or another criminal offence the aim of which is to cause death or serious bodily injury to a civilian or other person not actively involved in an armed conflict, if the purpose of that act is to intimidate the population or to compel a state or international organisation to do or refrain from doing something,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(2) The penalty under paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever directly or indirectly provides or collects funds with the aim that they be used or knowing that they will be used, in whole or in part, by a terrorist or terrorist association.  
(3) The funds under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be confiscated.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
Public incitement to terrorism

## Article 99

Whoever publicly presents or disseminates ideas which directly or indirectly incite the commission of a criminal offence under Article 97, Article 98, Article 137, Article 216 paragraphs 1 to 3, Article 219, Article 223, Article 224, Articles 352 to 355 of this Act,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
Recruitment for terrorism

## Article 100. (NN 118/18)

Whoever recruits another person to join a terrorist association for the purpose of committing or contributing to the commission of a criminal offence under Article 97 or committing a criminal offence under Article 102, Article 137, Article 216 paragraphs 1 to 3, Article 219, Article 223, Article 224, Articles 352 to 355 of this Act,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
CASE LAW: Decision

## Članak 101. (NN 118/18)

(1) Tko daje upute o izradi i korištenju eksplozivnih naprava, vatrenog ili drugog oružja ili štetnih ili opasnih tvari ili o drugim specifičnim metodama ili tehnikama znajući da se te vještine namjeravaju koristiti za počinjenje ili doprinos u počinjenju kaznenog djela iz članka 97. ili za počinjenje kaznenog djela iz članka 98., članka 137., članka 216. stavka 1. do 3., članka 219., članka 223., članka 224., članka 352. do članka 355. ovoga Zakona,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(2) Tko prima upute ili samostalno stječe znanja o izradi i korištenju eksplozivnih naprava, vatrenog ili drugog oružja, ili štetnih, ili opasnih tvari, ili o drugim specifičnim metodama, ili tehnikama znajući da se te vještine namjeravaju koristiti za počinjenje ili doprinos u počinjenju kaznenog djela iz članka 97. ili počinjenje kaznenog djela iz članka 98., članka 137., članka 216. stavka 1. do 3., članka 219., članka 223., članka 224., članka 352. do članka 355. ovoga Zakona, kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
Putovanje u svrhu terorizma

## Članak 101.a (NN 118/18)

Tko putuje u svrhu počinjenja ili doprinosa u počinjenju kaznenog djela iz članka 97. ili počinjenja kaznenog djela iz članka 101. i članka 102. ovoga Zakona, kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
Terorističko udruženje

## Članak 102

(1) Tko organizira ili vodi zločinačko udruženje kojemu je cilj počinjenje kaznenog djela iz članka 97. do članka 101., članka 137., članka 216. stavka 1. do 3., članka 219., članka 223., članka 224., članka 352. do članka 355. ovoga Zakona ili drugog kaznenog djela kojem je cilj prouzročiti smrt ili tešku tjelesnu ozljedu civila ili druge osobe koja nije aktivno uključena u oružani sukob, ako je svrha tog djela zastrašiti stanovništvo ili prisiliti neku državu ili međunarodnu organizaciju da što učini ili ne učini,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od tri do petnaest godina.  
(2) Tko postane pripadnikom zločinačkog udruženja iz stavka 1. ovoga članka, ili poduzme radnju za koju zna da pridonosi ostvarenju cilja terorističkog udruženja,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(3) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka koji pravodobnim otkrivanjem terorističkog udruženja spriječi počinjenje kaznenih djela navedenih u stavku 1. ovoga članka ili pripadnik terorističkog udruženja koji ga otkrije prije nego što u njegovom sastavu ili za njega počini kazneno djelo navedeno u stavku 1. ovoga članka može se osloboditi kazne.  
Pripremanje kaznenih djela protiv vrijednosti zaštićenih međunarodnim pravom

## Članak 103. (NN 56/15)

Tko priprema počinjenje kaznenih djela iz članka 88. do članka 91. i članka 97. do članka 102. ovoga Zakona,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
Mučenje i drugo okrutno, neljudsko ili ponižavajuće postupanje ili kažnjavanje

## Članak 104

Službena osoba ili osoba koja na poticaj ili s izričitim ili prešutnim pristankom službene osobe ili druge osobe koja djeluje u svojstvu službene osobe prouzroči drugome tešku tjelesnu ili duševnu bol ili patnju da bi od njega ili druge osobe dobila obavijest ili priznanje, ili da bi ga kaznila za djelo što ga je počinio ili je osumnjičen da ga je počinio on ili neka druga osoba, ili da bi se on ili druga osoba zastrašila ili da bi se na njega ili drugu osobu izvršio pritisak, ili zbog bilo kojeg razloga utemeljenog na bilo kojem obliku diskriminacije,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
Ropstvo

## Članak 105

(1) Tko kršeći pravila međunarodnog prava stavi drugog u ropski ili njemu sličan odnos ili ga drži u takvom odnosu, kupi, proda, preda ili posreduje u kupnji, prodaji ili predaji takve osobe ili potiče drugog da proda svoju slobodu ili slobodu osobe koju uzdržava ili se o njoj brine,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(2) Tko prevozi ljude koji se nalaze u ropskom ili njemu sličnom odnosu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Tko djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. počini prema djetetu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od tri do petnaest godina.  
Trgovanje ljudima

## Članak 106

(1) Tko uporabom sile ili prijetnje, obmanom, prijevarom, otmicom, zlouporabom ovlasti ili teškog položaja ili odnosa ovisnosti, davanjem ili primanjem novčane naknade ili druge koristi radi dobivanja pristanka osobe koja ima nadzor nad drugom osobom, ili na drugi način vrbuje, preveze, prevede, skriva ili prima osobu ili razmjenjuje ili prenosi nadzor nad osobom radi iskorištavanja njezinog rada putem prisilnog rada ili služenja, uspostavom ropstva ili njemu sličnog odnosa, ili radi njezinog iskorištavanja za prostituciju ili druge oblike spolnog iskorištavanja uključujući i pornografiju ili za sklapanje nedozvoljenog ili prisilnog braka, ili radi uzimanja dijelova njezinog tijela, ili radi njezinog korištenja u oružanim sukobima ili radi činjenja protupravne radnje,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko vrbuje, preveze, prevede, skriva ili prima dijete, ili razmjenjuje ili prenosi nadzor nad djetetom radi iskorištavanja njegovog rada putem prisilnog rada ili služenja, uspostavom ropstva ili njemu sličnog odnosa, ili radi njegovog iskorištavanja za prostituciju ili druge oblike spolnog iskorištavanja uključujući i pornografiju ili za sklapanje nedozvoljenog ili prisilnog braka ili za nezakonito posvojenje, ili radi uzimanja dijelova njegovog tijela, ili radi njegovog korištenja u oružanim sukobima.  
(3) Ako je kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinjeno prema djetetu, ili je kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ili 2. ovoga članka počinila službena osoba u obavljanju svoje službe, ili je počinjeno u odnosu na veći broj osoba, ili je svjesno doveden u opasnost život jedne ili više osoba,
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od tri do petnaest godina.  
(4) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko znajući da je osoba žrtva trgovanja ljudima koristi njezine usluge koje su rezultat jednog od oblika njezinog iskorištavanja navedenog u stavku 1. i 2. ovoga članka.  
(5) Tko s ciljem omogućavanja počinjenja djela iz stavka 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka zadrži, oduzme, sakrije, ošteti ili uništi putnu ispravu ili ispravu o dokazivanju identiteta druge osobe,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(6) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 5. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
(7) Pristanak na iskorištavanje same osobe na čiju štetu je trgovanje ljudima počinjeno bez utjecaja je na postojanje tog kaznenog djela.  
Trgovanje dijelovima ljudskog tijela i ljudskim zamecima

(1) Whoever gives instructions on the production and use of explosive devices, firearms or other weapons or harmful or dangerous substances or on other specific methods or techniques knowing that these skills are intended to be used for the commission of or contribution to the commission of a criminal offence under Article 97 or for the commission of a criminal offence under Article 98, Article 137, Article 216 paragraphs 1 to 3, Article 219, Article 223, Article 224, Articles 352 to 355 of this Act,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(2) Whoever receives instructions or independently acquires knowledge on the production and use of explosive devices, firearms or other weapons, or harmful or dangerous substances, or on other specific methods or techniques knowing that these skills are intended to be used for the commission of or contribution to the commission of a criminal offence under Article 97 or the commission of a criminal offence under Article 98, Article 137, Article 216 paragraphs 1 to 3, Article 219, Article 223, Article 224, Articles 352 to 355 of this Act, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
Travelling for the purpose of terrorism

## Članak 101.a (NN 118/18)

Whoever travels for the purpose of committing or contributing to the commission of a criminal offence under Article 97 or committing a criminal offence under Articles 101 and 102 of this Act, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
Terrorist association

## Članak 102

(1) Whoever organises or leads a criminal association whose aim is the commission of a criminal offence under Articles 97 to 101, Article 137, Article 216 paragraphs 1 to 3, Article 219, Article 223, Article 224, Articles 352 to 355 of this Act or another criminal offence whose aim is to cause death or serious bodily injury to civilians or other persons not actively involved in armed conflict, if the purpose of that act is to intimidate the population or to compel a state or international organisation to do or refrain from doing something,
shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
(2) Whoever becomes a member of a criminal association under paragraph 1 of this Article, or undertakes an act knowing that it contributes to the achievement of the aim of a terrorist association,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(3) The perpetrator of a criminal offence under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article who by timely disclosure of the terrorist association prevents the commission of the criminal offences referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article or a member of a terrorist association who discloses it before committing a criminal offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article within it or for it may be exempted from punishment.  
Preparation of criminal offences against values protected by international law

## Članak 103. (NN 56/15)

Whoever prepares the commission of criminal offences under Articles 88 to 91 and Articles 97 to 102 of this Act,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Torture and other cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment

## Članak 104

An official person or a person who at the instigation or with the express or tacit consent of an official person or another person acting in an official capacity inflicts severe physical or mental pain or suffering on another in order to obtain information or a confession from him or another person, or to punish him for an act he has committed or is suspected of having committed or which another person has committed, or to intimidate him or another person or to exert pressure on him or another person, or for any reason based on any form of discrimination,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
Slavery

## Članak 105

(1) Whoever in violation of the rules of international law places another in slavery or a similar relationship or keeps him in such a relationship, buys, sells, transfers or acts as an intermediary in the purchase, sale or transfer of such a person or incites another to sell his freedom or the freedom of a person he maintains or cares for,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(2) Whoever transports persons who are in slavery or a similar relationship,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) Whoever commits the act under paragraphs 1 and 2 against a child,
shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
Trafficking in human beings

## Članak 106

(1) Whoever by the use of force or threat, deception, fraud, abduction, abuse of authority or a position of vulnerability or a relationship of dependence, giving or receiving monetary compensation or other benefits in order to obtain the consent of a person having control over another person, or in another way recruits, transports, transfers, harbours or receives a person or exchanges or transfers control over a person for the purpose of exploiting his labour through forced labour or service, establishing slavery or a similar relationship, or for the purpose of exploiting him for prostitution or other forms of sexual exploitation including pornography or for entering into an unlawful or forced marriage, or for the purpose of removing parts of his body, or for the purpose of using him in armed conflicts or for committing an unlawful act,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje
(2) The punishment under paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever recruits, transports, transfers, harbours or receives a child, or exchanges or transfers control over a child for the purpose of exploiting his labour through forced labour or service, establishing slavery or a similar relationship, or for the purpose of exploiting him for prostitution or other forms of sexual exploitation including pornography or for entering into an unlawful or forced marriage or for unlawful adoption, or for the purpose of removing parts of his body, or for the purpose of using him in armed conflicts.  
(3) If the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article was committed against a child, or if the criminal offence under paragraph 1 or 2 of this Article was committed by an official person in the performance of his duties, or was committed in relation to a larger number of persons, or the life of one or more persons was knowingly endangered,
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
(4) The punishment under paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever knowing that a person is a victim of trafficking in human beings uses his services which are the result of one of the forms of his exploitation referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.  
(5) Whoever with the aim of enabling the commission of the act under paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article withholds, takes away, conceals, damages or destroys a travel document or identity document of another person,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(6) For the attempt of a criminal offence under paragraph 5 of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(7) The consent to exploitation of the person himself at whose expense trafficking in human beings was committed is without effect on the existence of that criminal offence.

## Članak 107. (NN 118/18)

(1) Tko nabavi, posjeduje, prevozi, prenosi, čuva, primi ili presadi ljudski organ, tkivo, stanicu, zametak ili fetus ako je znao ili morao i mogao znati da potiču od osobe koja je žrtva trgovine ljudima radi uzimanja dijelova tijela iz članka 106. ovoga Zakona,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(2) Tko uporabom sile ili prijetnje, obmanom, prijevarom, otmicom, zlouporabom ovlasti ili teškog položaja ili odnosa ovisnosti nabavi, posjeduje, prevozi, prenosi, čuva ili primi ljudski organ, tkivo, stanicu, zametak, fetus ili mrtvo tijelo radi uzimanja dijelova tijela,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
(3) Tko dajući novčanu naknadu ili drugu usporedivu korist nabavi ljudski organ, tkivo, stanicu, zametak, fetus ili mrtvo tijelo,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(4) Kaznom iz stavka 3. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko radi zarade navede drugog ili mu pomogne dati vlastiti organ, tkivo, stanicu, zametak ili fetus za novčanu naknadu ili drugu korist.  
(5) Tko izvadi ili presadi ljudski organ, tkivo, stanicu, zametak ili fetus ako je znao ili je morao i mogao znati da je za njega darivatelj dobio novčanu naknadu ili drugu korist,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(6) Kaznom iz stavka 5. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko oglašava potrebu ili dostupnost ljudskog organa, tkiva, stanice, zametka, fetusa ili mrtvog tijela radi ponude ili traženja novčane naknade ili druge koristi.  
Kloniranje i promjena ljudskog genoma

## Članak 108. (144/12)

(1) Tko postupa s ciljem stvaranja ljudskog bića koje s drugim živim ili mrtvim ljudskim bićem dijeli isti set gena stanične jezgre,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(2) Tko poduzme zahvat usmjeren na promjenu ljudskoga genoma koji nije za preventivne, dijagnostičke ili terapijske svrhe, ili koji je za preventivne, dijagnostičke ili terapijske svrhe, ali je cilj promjene uvođenje preinaka u genomu potomka pacijenta,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.

Povreda prava na okupljanje i prosvjed

## Članak 128

kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko silom, ozbiljnom prijetnjom ili na drugi način spriječi, onemogući ili znatno ometa javno okupljanje ili mirni prosvjed koji je organiziran u skladu sa zakonom.

kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
Povreda slobode vjere

## Članak 130

kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko vjerskoj zajednici koja djeluje u skladu sa zakonom uskrati pravo jednakosti s drugim vjerskim zajednicama u Republici Hrvatskoj ili joj uskrati ili ograniči javno obavljati vjerske obrede, osnivati škole, učilišta, zavode, socijalne ili dobrotvorne ustanove i upravljati njima.

## Članak 140. (NN 56/15, 126/19)

(1) Tko ustrajno i kroz dulje vrijeme prati ili uhodi drugu osobu ili s njom nastoji uspostaviti ili uspostavlja neželjeni kontakt ili je na drugi način zastrašuje i time kod nje izazove tjeskobu ili strah za njezinu sigurnost ili sigurnost njoj bliskih osoba,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje, Rješenje, Rješenje
(2) Ako je djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinjeno u odnosu na blisku osobu, osobu s kojom je počinitelj bio u intimnoj vezi ili prema djetetu, počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Rješenje
(3) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu, osim ako je počinjeno prema djetetu ili bliskoj osobi.  
Narušavanje nepovredivosti doma i poslovnog prostora
(1) Tko neovlašteno prodre u tuđi dom ili poslovni prostoru ili zatvoreni ili ograđeni prostor koji pripada tom domu ili poslovnom prostoru ili se na zahtjev ovlaštene osobe otuda ne udalji,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje
(2) Ako kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počini službena osoba u obavljanju službe ili odgovorna osoba u obavljanju javne ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(3) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu.  
Povreda tajnosti pisama i drugih pošiljaka

## Članak 142. (NN 56/15)

(1) Tko neovlašteno otvori tuđu pošiljku, pismo, brzojav, elektroničku poštu ili kakvo drugo sredstvo dopisivanja, ili na drugi način povrijedi njihovu tajnost, ili neovlašteno zadrži, prikrije, uništi ili drugome preda tuđu zatvorenu pošiljku ili pismo, brzojav, elektroničku poštu ili kakvo drugo sredstvo dopisivanja,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Tko s ciljem da sebi ili drugome pribavi kakvu imovinsku korist ili da drugome prouzroči kakvu štetu priopći drugome podatak koji je saznao povredom tajnosti tuđe pošiljke, pisma, brzojava, elektroničke pošte ili kakvog drugog sredstva dopisivanja, ili se s tom tajnom posluži,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do dvije godine.  
(3) Ako kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka počini službena osoba u obavljanju službe ili odgovorna osoba u obavljanju javne ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(4) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu.  
Neovlašteno zvučno snimanje i prisluškivanje

## Članak 143. (NN 56/15)

(1) Tko neovlašteno zvučno snimi nejavno izgovorene riječi drugoga ili tko posebnim napravama neovlašteno prisluškuje nejavno izgovorene riječi drugoga koje mu nisu namijenjene,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko snimljene riječi iz stavka 1. uporabi ili učini dostupnim trećoj osobi ili tko prisluškivane riječi iz stavka 1. doslovce ili u bitnim crtama javno iznese.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(3) Ako kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka počini službena osoba u obavljanju službe ili odgovorna osoba u obavljanju javne ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(4) Nema kaznenog djela ako su radnje iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka učinjene u javnom interesu ili drugom interesu koji je pretežniji od interesa zaštite privatnosti snimane ili prisluškivane osobe.  
(5) Kaznena djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka progone se po prijedlogu.  
(6) Snimke i posebne naprave kojima je počinjeno kazneno djelo iz ovoga članka će se oduzeti.  
Neovlašteno slikovno snimanje

## Članak 144. (NN 56/15)

(1) Tko drugoga koji se nalazi u stanu ili prostoru posebno zaštićenom od pogleda neovlašteno slikovno snimi ili takvu snimku uporabi ili učini dostupnom trećoj osobi i na taj način povrijedi njegovu privatnost,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Ako kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počini službena osoba u obavljanju službe ili odgovorna osoba u obavljanju javne ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(3) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu.  
(4) Snimke i posebne naprave kojima je počinjeno kazneno djelo iz ovoga članka će se oduzeti.  
Zlouporaba snimke spolno eksplicitnog sadržaja

## Članak 144.a (NN 84/21)

(1) Tko zlouporabi odnos povjerenja i bez pristanka snimane osobe učini dostupnim trećoj osobi snimku spolno eksplicitnog sadržaja koja je snimljena uz pristanak te osobe za osobnu uporabu i na taj način povrijedi privatnost te osobe, kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko uporabom računalnog sustava ili na drugi način izradi novu ili preinači postojeću snimku spolno eksplicitnog sadržaja i tu snimku uporabi kao pravu te time povrijedi privatnost osobe na toj snimci.  
(3) Tko kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka počini putem računalnog sustava ili mreže ili na drugi način zbog čega je snimka postala dostupna većem broju osoba, kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(4) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu.  
(5) Snimke i posebne naprave kojima je počinjeno kazneno djelo iz ovoga članka će se oduzeti.  
Neovlašteno otkrivanje profesionalne tajne

## Članak 145. (144/12)

(1) Odvjetnik, javni bilježnik, zdravstveni radnik, psiholog, djelatnik ustanove socijalne skrbi, vjerski ispovjednik ili druga osoba koja neovlašteno otkrije podatak o osobnom ili obiteljskom životu koji joj je povjeren u obavljanju njezinog zvanja,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Nema kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka ako je otkrivanje tajne počinjeno u javnom interesu ili interesu druge osobe koji je pretežniji od interesa čuvanja tajne.  
(3) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu.  
Nedozvoljena uporaba osobnih podataka

## Članak 146. (NN 56/15)

(1) Tko protivno uvjetima određenima u zakonu prikuplja, obrađuje ili koristi osobne podatke fizičkih osoba,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Rješenje
(2) Tko protivno uvjetima određenima u zakonu iznosi osobne podatke iz Republike Hrvatske u svrhu daljnje obrade ili ih objavi ili na drugi način učini dostupnim drugome ili tko radnjom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka sebi ili drugome pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 2. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počini prema djetetu ili tko protivno uvjetima određenima u zakonu prikuplja, obrađuje ili koristi osobne podatke fizičkih osoba koji se odnose na rasno ili etničko podrijetlo, politička stajališta, vjerska ili druga uvjerenja, sindikalno članstvo, zdravlje ili spolni život te osobne podatke fizičkih osoba o kaznenom ili prekršajnom postupku.  
(4) Ako kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. do 3. ovoga članka počini službena osoba u obavljanju službe ili odgovorna osoba u obavljanju javne ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
Uvreda

## Članak 147. (NN 56/15)

(1) Tko uvrijedi drugoga,
kaznit će se novčanom kaznom do devedeset dnevnih iznosa.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Presuda
(2) Tko djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počini putem tiska, radija, televizije, računalnog sustava ili mreže, na javnom skupu ili na drugi način zbog čega je uvreda postala pristupačnom većem broju osoba,
kaznit će se novčanom kaznom do sto osamdeset dnevnih iznosa.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda
(3) Ako uvrijeđeni uzvrati uvredu, sud može oba počinitelja osloboditi kazne.  
(4) Ako je počinitelj bio izazvan nedoličnim ponašanjem oštećenika, ili je oštećenik pred sudom prihvatio njegovu ispriku zbog počinjenog djela, sud ga može osloboditi kazne.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje

## Članak 148. (NN 56/15, 126/19)

Brisan.  
Isključenje protupravnosti za kazneno djelo uvrede

(1) Whoever persistently and over a longer period of time follows or stalks another person or attempts to establish or establishes unwanted contact with them or otherwise intimidates them and thereby causes them anxiety or fear for their safety or the safety of persons close to them,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision
(2) If the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is committed against a close person, a person with whom the perpetrator was in an intimate relationship or against a child, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Decision
(3) The criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon proposal, unless it is committed against a child or a close person.  
Violation of the Inviolability of Home and Business Premises
(1) Whoever unlawfully intrudes into another's home or business premises or into a closed or fenced area belonging to that home or business premises or does not leave from there at the request of an authorised person,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision
(2) If the criminal offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by an official person in the performance of their duties or a responsible person in the performance of public authority,
they shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.

Violation of the Secrecy of Letters and Other Consignments

## Article 142. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever unlawfully opens another's consignment, letter, telegram, electronic mail or any other means of correspondence, or otherwise violates their secrecy, or unlawfully withholds, conceals, destroys or delivers to another person another's sealed consignment or letter, telegram, electronic mail or any other means of correspondence,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(2) Whoever, with the aim of obtaining for themselves or another some pecuniary benefit or causing some damage to another, communicates to another person information which they learned by violating the secrecy of another's consignment, letter, telegram, electronic mail or any other means of correspondence, or makes use of that secret,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.  
(3) If the criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article is committed by an official person in the performance of their duties or a responsible person in the performance of public authority,
they shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(4) The criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon proposal.  
Unauthorised Audio Recording and Eavesdropping

## Article 143. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever unlawfully audio records non-publicly spoken words of another or whoever unlawfully eavesdrops with special devices on non-publicly spoken words of another which are not intended for them,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Decision
(2) The penalty referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever uses the recorded words from paragraph 1 or makes them accessible to a third person or whoever publicly presents the eavesdropped words from paragraph 1 verbatim or in essential features.  
CASE LAW: Decision
(3) If the criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article is committed by an official person in the performance of their duties or a responsible person in the performance of public authority,
they shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(4) There is no criminal offence if the acts referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article are committed in the public interest or another interest which is more important than the interest of protecting the privacy of the recorded or eavesdropped person.  
(5) The criminal offences referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon proposal.  
(6) Recordings and special devices with which the criminal offence referred to in this Article was committed shall be confiscated.  
Unauthorised Image Recording

## Article 144. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever unlawfully image records another person who is in an apartment or space specially protected from view or uses such a recording or makes it accessible to a third person and thereby violates their privacy,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(2) If the criminal offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by an official person in the performance of their duties or a responsible person in the performance of public authority,
they shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(3) The criminal offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon proposal.  
(4) Recordings and special devices with which the criminal offence referred to in this Article was committed shall be confiscated.  
Abuse of Recording of Sexually Explicit Content

## Article 144.a (NN 84/21)

(1) Whoever abuses a relationship of trust and without the consent of the recorded person makes accessible to a third person a recording of sexually explicit content which was recorded with the consent of that person for personal use and thereby violates the privacy of that person, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(2) The penalty referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever by using a computer system or otherwise creates a new or alters an existing recording of sexually explicit content and uses that recording as genuine and thereby violates the privacy of the person in that recording.  
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article via a computer system or network or otherwise whereby the recording has become accessible to a larger number of persons, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(4) The criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon proposal.  
(5) Recordings and special devices with which the criminal offence referred to in this Article was committed shall be confiscated.  
Unauthorised Disclosure of Professional Secret

## Article 145. (144/12)

(1) A lawyer, public notary, health worker, psychologist, employee of a social welfare institution, religious confessor or other person who unlawfully discloses information about personal or family life which was entrusted to them in the performance of their profession,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(2) There is no criminal offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article if the disclosure of the secret was committed in the public interest or the interest of another person which is more important than the interest of keeping the secret.  
(3) The criminal offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon proposal.  
Unauthorised Use of Personal Data

## Article 146. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever, contrary to the conditions determined by law, collects, processes or uses personal data of natural persons,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Decision
(2) Whoever, contrary to the conditions determined by law, transfers personal data from the Republic of Croatia for the purpose of further processing or publishes them or otherwise makes them accessible to another or whoever by the act referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article obtains for themselves or another considerable pecuniary benefit or causes considerable damage,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(3) The penalty referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever commits the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article against a child or whoever, contrary to the conditions determined by law, collects, processes or uses personal data of natural persons relating to racial or ethnic origin, political views, religious or other beliefs, trade union membership, health or sexual life and personal data of natural persons concerning criminal or misdemeanour proceedings.  
(4) If the criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 to 3 of this Article is committed by an official person in the performance of their duties or a responsible person in the performance of public authority,
they shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
Insult

## Article 147. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever insults another,
shall be punished by a fine of up to ninety daily amounts.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Judgment
(2) Whoever commits the offence referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article through the press, radio, television, computer system or network, at a public gathering or otherwise whereby the insult has become accessible to a larger number of persons,
shall be punished by a fine of up to one hundred and eighty daily amounts.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment
(3) If the insulted person returns the insult, the court may release both perpetrators from punishment.  
(4) If the perpetrator was provoked by improper behaviour of the injured party, or if the injured party accepted their apology before the court for the committed offence, the court may release them from punishment.  
CASE LAW: Decision

Deleted.

Whoever, by breaching their legal family obligations, leaves a close person who cannot take care of themselves in a difficult situation,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
Breach of maintenance obligation

## Article 172

(1) Whoever fails to maintain a person whom they are obliged by law to maintain, in the manner, amount and within the time limits determined by an enforcement document,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision, Judgment
(2) If the obligation under paragraph 1 of this Article relates to the maintenance of a child or a person who is incapable of work due to age, illness, mental or physical disability,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Decision
(3) There is no criminal offence if the perpetrator proves that for justified reasons they were unable to pay the maintenance under paragraph 1 or 2 of this Article.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment, Decision
Failure to implement a decision for the protection of the welfare of a child and other vulnerable groups or acting contrary to professional rules

## Article 173. (144/12, 56/15, 84/21)

(1) Whoever fails to implement, prevents or obstructs the implementation of a decision for the protection of the welfare of a child and other vulnerable persons due to their age, serious physical or mental disorder or pregnancy, ordered by a court, social welfare centre or state body, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(2) An official person working in an institution or state body or a responsible person in the exercise of public authority who fails to implement decisions of courts or state bodies for the protection of a child and other vulnerable persons due to their age, serious physical or mental disorder or pregnancy, thereby endangering the health or development of the child, or the health and welfare of the vulnerable person, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(3) An official person working in an institution or state body or a responsible person in the exercise of public authority who fails to fulfil legal obligations in a timely manner or manifestly fails to act according to professional rules in the protection of a child and other vulnerable persons due to their age, serious physical or mental disorder or pregnancy, thereby endangering the health or development of the child, or the health and welfare of the vulnerable person, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(4) If the criminal offence under paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article was committed through negligence, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(5) A perpetrator who enables the implementation of the decision under paragraph 1 of this Article before the commencement of criminal proceedings may be exempted from punishment.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment, Judgment
Abduction of a child

## Article 174

(1) Whoever takes a child away from a parent, adoptive parent, guardian, another person or institution to whom it has been entrusted, unlawfully retains it or prevents it from living with the person or in the institution to whom it has been entrusted,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) If the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by a parent or adoptive parent,
they shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article with the aim of permanently retaining the child, or if due to the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article the child left the territory of the Republic of Croatia, or the child's health, upbringing, education is seriously endangered or the child's welfare is seriously endangered in another way,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(4) A parent or adoptive parent who commits the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article with the aim of permanently retaining the child or in such a way that the child leaves the territory of the Republic of Croatia,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(5) If the criminal offence under paragraphs 1, 2, 3 and 4 of this Article caused the death of the child,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
(6) For an attempt of the criminal offence under paragraph 2 of this Article, the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(7) A perpetrator who returns the child before the commencement of criminal proceedings may be exempted from punishment.  
Change of family status

## Article 175

(1) Whoever, by substitution, exchange, providing false information or in another way, changes the family status of a child,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) Whoever through negligence exchanges or in another way changes the family status of a child,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(3) For an attempt of the criminal offence under paragraph 1 of this Article, the perpetrator shall be punished.  
Abandonment of a child

## Article 176

Whoever abandons their child with the aim of permanently getting rid of it,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
Violation of children's rights

(1) A parent, adoptive parent, guardian or another person who grossly neglects their duties of raising, upbringing and educating a child,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to three years.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Decision
(2) Whoever abuses a child or forces it to excessive work or work that does not correspond to its age, to begging or induces it to other behaviour that is harmful to its development or in another way grossly violates children's rights,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to five years.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision, Judgment, Judgment
(3) If due to the criminal offence under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article the child engaged in begging, prostitution or other forms of socially unacceptable behaviour, or serious bodily injury to the child was caused,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
(4) If the criminal offence under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article caused the death of the child,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
CASE LAW: Decision
Violation of a child's privacy

## Article 178

(1) Whoever discloses or disseminates something from the personal or family life of a child, publishes the child's photograph contrary to regulations or reveals the child's identity, which caused disturbance to the child, ridicule by peers or other persons or in another way endangered the child's welfare,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year.  
(2) Whoever commits the act under paragraph 1 of this Article through the press, radio, television, computer system or network, at a public gathering or in another way whereby it became accessible to a larger number of persons,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to two years.

(3) Whoever commits the act under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article as an official person or in the exercise of professional activity,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Decision
