## Article 274. (NN 144/12, 56/15)

(1) Whoever produces counterfeit money, alters genuine money or acquires, possesses, imports, exports, receives or transfers such money with the aim of putting it into circulation as genuine or puts it into circulation as genuine,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision
(2) Whoever puts into circulation counterfeit money which he received believing it to be genuine, having learned that it is counterfeit,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(3) For an attempt of the criminal offence referred to in paragraph 2, the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(4) Counterfeit money shall be confiscated.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision
Counterfeiting of securities

## Article 275. (NN 144/12)

(1) Whoever produces a counterfeit security with the aim of putting it into circulation as genuine which is issued on the basis of regulations, alters a genuine security or acquires such counterfeit security or puts it into circulation as genuine,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(2) Whoever puts into circulation a counterfeit security which he received believing it to be genuine, having learned that it is counterfeit,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(3) Counterfeit securities shall be confiscated.  
Counterfeiting of tokens of value

## Article 276

(1) Whoever produces counterfeit stamps, postage stamps or other tokens of value issued on the basis of regulations or alters them, acquires them or gives them to another for use with the aim of using them as genuine,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) Whoever by removing a mark from a token of value or in another manner acts on an already used token of value in order to give it the appearance of an unused token or whoever reuses an already used token of value or sells it as if it were unused,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to six months.  
(3) Counterfeit tokens of value shall be confiscated.  
Counterfeiting of marks for marking goods, measures and weights

## Article 277

(1) Whoever with the aim of using them as genuine produces counterfeit marks for marking goods, such as seals, stamps or marks with which gold, silver, livestock, wood or any other goods are marked or alters such genuine marks, or whoever uses counterfeit marks as genuine,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) Whoever counterfeits measures or weights,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(3) Counterfeit marks, measures and weights and means for their production shall be confiscated.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment
Forgery of documents

## Article 278. (NN 84/21)

(1) Whoever produces a false document or alters a genuine one with the aim of using such document as genuine or whoever acquires such document for use or uses it as genuine or in another manner makes it available to another for use,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Decision, Judgment
(2) The punishment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever deceives another about the content of a document and the latter puts his signature on that document, believing that he is signing some other document or some other content.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article with respect to a public document, will, bill of exchange, cheque, payment card or other non-cash payment instrument or public or official book which must be kept on the basis of law,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision, Judgment
(4) For an attempt of the criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, the perpetrator shall be punished.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment
Forgery of official or business documents

## Article 279

(1) An official or responsible person who enters false data into an official or business document, book or file, or fails to enter some important data, or with his signature or official seal certifies such document, book or file with false content or who with his signature or official seal enables the production of a document, book or file with false content,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Decision, Judgment
(2) The punishment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall also be imposed on whoever uses a false official or business document, book or file in official duties or business as if they were genuine.  
CASE LAW: Decision, JudgmentandDecision, Decision, Decision, Judgment
Misuse of personal documents

## Article 280

Whoever fraudulently uses in legal transactions a personal document issued in the name of another person or for the purpose of fraud in legal transactions transfers to another person a personal document which was not issued in the name of that person,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.  
CASE LAW: Judgment
Certification of false content

## Article 281

(1) Whoever by misleading the competent authority causes it to certify in a public document, record or book something false which is to serve as evidence in legal transactions,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) The punishment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever uses such document, record or book, although he knows that they are false.  
Issuance and use of false medical or veterinary certificates

## Article 282

Whoever enters false data into a medical or veterinary certificate or whoever uses such certificate,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
Production, acquisition, possession, sale or making available for use of means for counterfeiting

## Article 283. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever produces, receives, acquires, possesses, sells or makes available for use devices, objects, computer programs and computer data and other means for counterfeiting or altering money or security features such as holograms, watermarks or other components of money which serve to protect against counterfeiting, shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) The punishment referred to in paragraph 1 shall be imposed on whoever produces, receives, acquires, possesses, sells or makes available for use devices, objects, computer programs and computer data and other means for producing counterfeit securities, counterfeit tokens of value issued on the basis of regulations, counterfeit marks for marking goods, counterfeit measures and weights and forged documents.  
(3) The means referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall be confiscated.  
Violation of personal rights of authors or performing artists

## Article 284

(1) Whoever contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights marks another's copyrighted work under a false name, his own name or the name of another and publishes it or uses it or allows this to be done, or marks a work with the author's name contrary to the author's prohibition,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.  
(2) The punishment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights marks another's performance of a performing artist under a false name, his own name or the name of another or marks it with the name of the performing artist contrary to the prohibition of the performing artist and publishes it or uses it or allows this to be done.  
(3) The punishment referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights incorporates parts of another's copyrighted work or another's performance of a performing artist into his own copyrighted work or into his own performance with the aim of obtaining benefit or causing damage.  
(4) The criminal offence referred to in paragraphs 1 to 3 of this Article shall be prosecuted upon a proposal of the injured party or other interested person.  
Unauthorized use of copyrighted work or performance of a performing artist

(1) Tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuju autorsko i srodna prava reproducira, preradi, distribuira, skladišti ili poduzima druge radnje radi distribucije ili priopći javnosti na bilo koji način tuđe autorsko djelo ili dopusti da se to učini i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuje autorsko i srodna prava fiksira tuđu nefiksiranu izvedbu umjetnika izvođača, reproducira, preradi, distribuira, skladišti ili poduzima druge radnje radi distribucije tuđe fiksirane izvedbe umjetnika izvođača ili priopći javnosti na bilo koji način tuđu fiksiranu ili nefiksiranu izvedbu umjetnika izvođača ili dopusti da se to učini i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuju autorsko i srodna prava osujećuje tehničke mjere za zaštitu prava autora i umjetnika izvođača ili ukloni ili preinači podatke o upravljanju tim pravima i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu.  
(4) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
(5) Predmeti koji su bili namijenjeni ili uporabljeni za počinjenje kaznenog djela iz stavka 1., 2., 3. i 4. ovoga članka će se oduzeti, a predmeti koji su nastali počinjenjem tih kaznenih djela će se uništiti osim ako onaj čije je pravo povrijeđeno zatraži njihovu predaju uz naknadu koja ne može biti viša od troškova njihove proizvodnje. Naknada je prihod državnog proračuna i koristit će se za suzbijanje kaznenih djela protiv intelektualnog vlasništva.  
Povreda drugih autorskom srodnih prava

## Članak 286

(1) Tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuju autorsko i srodna prava reproducira, distribuira, skladišti ili poduzima druge radnje radi distribucije, ili stavi na raspolaganje javnosti tuđi fonogram ili dopusti da se to učini i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuju autorsko i srodna prava reproducira, distribuira, skladišti ili poduzima druge radnje radi distribucije, ili javno prikaže ili stavi na raspolaganje javnosti tuđi videogram ili dopusti da se to učini i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuju autorsko i srodna prava reemitira tuđe emitiranje, ili javno priopći tuđe emitiranje uz plaćanje ulaznica ili stavi na raspolaganje javnosti tuđe emitiranje ili dopusti da se to učini i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu.  
(4) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko protivno propisima kojima se uređuju autorsko i srodna prava osujećuje tehničke mjere za zaštitu srodnih prava proizvođača fonograma, videograma ili organizacija za radiodifuziju ili ukloni ili preinači podatke o upravljanju tim pravima ili dopusti da se to učini i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu.  
(5) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. do 4. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
(6) Predmeti koji su bili namijenjeni ili uporabljeni za počinjenje kaznenog djela iz stavka 1., 2., 3. i 4. ovoga članka će se oduzeti, a predmeti koji su nastali počinjenjem tih kaznenih djela će se uništiti osim ako onaj čije je pravo povrijeđeno zatraži njihovu predaju uz naknadu koja ne može biti viša od troškova njihove proizvodnje. Naknada je prihod državnog proračuna i koristit će se za suzbijanje kaznenih djela protiv intelektualnog vlasništva.  
Povreda prava na izum

## Članak 287

(1) Tko neovlašteno podnese prijavu za registraciju patenta ili u njoj protivno propisima o zaštiti patenta ne navede ili lažno navede izumitelja ili neovlašteno učini dostupnim javnosti izum prije nego što je on zakonito objavljen javnosti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
(2) Tko protivno propisima o zaštiti patenta izrađuje, nudi na prodaju, prodaje, rabi, izvozi, uvozi, ili skladišti u te svrhe proizvod izrađen prema izumu koji je zaštićen patentom ili svjedodžbom o dodatnoj zaštiti ili primjenjuje ili nudi primjenu postupka koji je predmet zaštićenog izuma ili nudi na prodaju, prodaje, rabi, izvozi, uvozi ili skladišti u te svrhe proizvod koji je izravno dobiven postupkom koji je predmet izuma i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(3) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 2. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
(4) Predmeti koji su bili namijenjeni ili uporabljeni za počinjenje kaznenog djela iz stavka 2. i 3. ovoga članka će se oduzeti, a predmeti koji su nastali počinjenjem kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka će se oduzeti i uništiti.  
(5) Kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka progoni se po prijedlogu oštećenika ili druge zainteresirane osobe.  
Povreda žiga

## Članak 288

(1) Tko protivno propisima o zaštiti žiga u trgovačkom prometu rabi znak koji je istovjetan sa zaštićenim žigom u odnosu na proizvode ili usluge koje su istovjetne s onima za koje je žig registriran ili znak koji je istovjetan ili sličan zaštićenom žigu u odnosu na proizvode ili usluge koji su istovjetni ili slični s onima za koje je žig registriran, ističući znak na proizvodima ili njihovim pakiranjima, nudeći ili stavljajući na tržište ili skladišteći u te svrhe proizvod pod tim znakom ili nudeći ili pružajući usluge pod tim znakom ili uvozeći ili izvozeći proizvode obilježene tim znakom ili rabeći znak na poslovnim proizvodima i u reklamiranju, čime javnost može biti dovedena u zabludu o podrijetlu proizvoda i usluga, i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu.  
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
(3) Predmeti koji su bili namijenjeni ili uporabljeni za počinjenje kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka će se oduzeti, a predmeti koji su nastali počinjenjem kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka će se oduzeti i uništiti, osim ako sud odluči da će se uporabljeni znak učiniti neraspoznatljivim, a predmete koji su nastali počinjenjem djela uporabiti u humanitarne svrhe.  
Povreda registrirane oznake podrijetla

## Članak 289

(1) Tko protivno propisima rabi oznaku izvornosti, oznaku zemljopisnog podrijetla proizvoda i usluga ili oznaku tradicionalnog ugleda poljoprivrednih i prehrambenih proizvoda i na taj način pribavi znatnu imovinsku korist ili prouzroči znatnu štetu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Predmeti koji su bili namijenjeni ili uporabljeni za počinjenje kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka će se oduzeti, a predmeti koji su nastali počinjenjem kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka će se oduzeti i uništiti, osim ako sud odluči da će se uporabljena oznaka učiniti neraspoznatljivom, a predmeti koji su nastali počinjenjem djela uporabiti u humanitarne svrhe.  
Javna objava presude

## Članak 290

Na zahtjev oštećenika kad ovaj za to ima opravdan interes presuda za kaznena djela iz ove glave će se javno objaviti o trošku počinitelja. Način objavljivanja odredit će se presudom.

## Članak 285. (NN 144/12)

(1) Whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, reproduces, adapts, distributes, stores or undertakes other actions for the purpose of distribution or communicates to the public in any manner another's copyrighted work or permits this to be done and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, fixes another's unfixed performance of a performing artist, reproduces, adapts, distributes, stores or undertakes other actions for the purpose of distribution of another's fixed performance of a performing artist or communicates to the public in any manner another's fixed or unfixed performance of a performing artist or permits this to be done and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage.  
(3) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, circumvents technical measures for the protection of the rights of authors and performing artists or removes or alters rights management information and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage.  
(4) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraphs 1., 2. and 3. of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(5) Objects that were intended or used for committing the criminal offense from paragraphs 1., 2., 3. and 4. of this Article shall be confiscated, and objects that resulted from the commission of these criminal offenses shall be destroyed unless the person whose right was violated requests their delivery with compensation that cannot be higher than the costs of their production. The compensation is revenue of the state budget and shall be used for combating criminal offenses against intellectual property.  
Violation of other copyright-related rights

## Članak 286

(1) Whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, reproduces, distributes, stores or undertakes other actions for the purpose of distribution, or makes available to the public another's phonogram or permits this to be done and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, reproduces, distributes, stores or undertakes other actions for the purpose of distribution, or publicly displays or makes available to the public another's videogram or permits this to be done and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage.  
(3) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, retransmits another's broadcast, or publicly communicates another's broadcast with payment of admission tickets or makes available to the public another's broadcast or permits this to be done and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage.  
(4) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, contrary to regulations governing copyright and related rights, circumvents technical measures for the protection of related rights of phonogram producers, videogram producers or broadcasting organizations or removes or alters rights management information or permits this to be done and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage.  
(5) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraphs 1. to 4. of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(6) Objects that were intended or used for committing the criminal offense from paragraphs 1., 2., 3. and 4. of this Article shall be confiscated, and objects that resulted from the commission of these criminal offenses shall be destroyed unless the person whose right was violated requests their delivery with compensation that cannot be higher than the costs of their production. The compensation is revenue of the state budget and shall be used for combating criminal offenses against intellectual property.  
Violation of the right to invention

## Članak 287

(1) Whoever without authorization submits an application for patent registration or in it, contrary to regulations on patent protection, does not state or falsely states the inventor or without authorization makes an invention available to the public before it has been lawfully published to the public,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.  
(2) Whoever, contrary to regulations on patent protection, manufactures, offers for sale, sells, uses, exports, imports, or stores for these purposes a product made according to an invention that is protected by a patent or supplementary protection certificate or applies or offers the application of a process that is the subject of a protected invention or offers for sale, sells, uses, exports, imports or stores for these purposes a product that is directly obtained by a process that is the subject of an invention and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(3) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraph 2. of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(4) Objects that were intended or used for committing the criminal offense from paragraphs 2. and 3. of this Article shall be confiscated, and objects that resulted from the commission of the criminal offense from paragraphs 1. and 2. of this Article shall be confiscated and destroyed.  
(5) The criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be prosecuted upon the proposal of the injured party or other interested person.  
Violation of trademark

## Članak 288

(1) Whoever, contrary to regulations on trademark protection, uses in commercial transactions a sign that is identical to a protected trademark in relation to products or services that are identical to those for which the trademark is registered or a sign that is identical or similar to a protected trademark in relation to products or services that are identical or similar to those for which the trademark is registered, by displaying the sign on products or their packaging, offering or placing on the market or storing for these purposes a product under that sign or offering or providing services under that sign or importing or exporting products marked with that sign or using the sign on business products and in advertising, whereby the public may be misled as to the origin of products and services, and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage.  
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
(3) Objects that were intended or used for committing the criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be confiscated, and objects that resulted from the commission of the criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be confiscated and destroyed, unless the court decides that the used sign shall be made unrecognizable and the objects that resulted from the commission of the act shall be used for humanitarian purposes.  
Violation of registered designation of origin

## Članak 289

(1) Whoever, contrary to regulations, uses a designation of origin, a geographical indication of products and services or a designation of traditional reputation of agricultural and food products and thereby acquires substantial material gain or causes substantial damage,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) Objects that were intended or used for committing the criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be confiscated, and objects that resulted from the commission of the criminal offense from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be confiscated and destroyed, unless the court decides that the used designation shall be made unrecognizable and the objects that resulted from the commission of the act shall be used for humanitarian purposes.  
Public announcement of judgment

## Članak 290

At the request of the injured party when they have a justified interest in this, the judgment for criminal offenses from this chapter shall be publicly announced at the expense of the perpetrator. The manner of publication shall be determined by the judgment.

(3) Nema kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kad njegova obilježja ostvari osoba koja je u braku ili koja živi u izvanbračnoj ili životnoj zajednici ili neformalnoj životnoj zajednici s osobom koja priprema neprijavljeno kazneno djelo ili je toj osobi srodnik po krvi u ravnoj lozi, brat ili sestra, posvojitelj ili posvojenik, osim ako se priprema kazneno djelo na štetu djeteta.  
(4) Za kazneno djelo iz stavka 2. ovoga članka može se blaže kazniti počinitelj koji je s osobom koja priprema počinjenje kaznenog djela u nekom od odnosa iz stavka 3. ovoga članka.  
Neprijavljivanje počinjenog kaznenog djela

## Članak 302. (NN 144/12, 56/15)

(1) Tko zna da je počinjeno kazneno djelo za koje je propisana kazna zatvora deset godina ili teža kazna pa to ne prijavi iako zna da bi takvom prijavom bilo omogućeno ili znatno olakšano otkrivanje djela ili počinitelja,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje, Rješenje, Rješenje
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se službena ili odgovorna osoba koja ne prijavi počinjenje kaznenog djela za koje je saznala obavljajući svoju dužnost, a radi se o kaznenom djelu za koje pokretanje kaznenog postupka nije prepušteno privatnoj tužbi ili progonu po prijedlogu.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(3) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 2. ovoga članka neće se kazniti kaznom strožom od one koja je propisana za kazneno djelo koje nije prijavio.  
(4) Nema kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kad njegova zakonska obilježja ostvari osoba koja je u braku ili koja živi u izvanbračnoj ili životnoj zajednici ili neformalnoj životnoj zajednici s osobom koja je počinila neprijavljeno kazneno djelo ili je toj osobi srodnik po krvi u ravnoj lozi, brat ili sestra, posvojitelj ili posvojenik, osim ako je djelo počinjeno prema djetetu.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje, Rješenje
(5) Nema kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka kad njegova zakonska obilježja ostvari vjerski ispovjednik ili osoba koja je prema zakonu dužna čuvati tajnu.  
Pomoć počinitelju nakon počinjenja kaznenog djela

## Članak 303. (NN 56/15)

(1) Tko krije ili zbrinjava počinitelja kaznenog djela za koje je propisana kazna zatvora od pet godina ili teža kazna ili mu prikrivanjem sredstava kojima je kazneno djelo počinjeno, tragova kaznenog djela ili predmeta nastalih ili pribavljenih kaznenim djelom ili na drugi način pomaže da ne bude otkriven ili uhićen,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko krije osobu koja je osuđena na kaznu zatvora ili na drugi način onemogućuje izvršenje te kazne.  
(3) Tko kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka počini u korist počinitelja kaznenog djela iz članka 88. do članka 91. ili članka 97. ovoga Zakona,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
(4) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 2. ovoga članka neće se kazniti kaznom strožom od one koja je propisana za kazneno djelo koje je počinila osoba kojoj je počinitelj pružio pomoć.  
(5) Nema kaznenog djela iz stavka 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka kad njegova zakonska obilježja ostvari osoba koja je u braku ili koja živi u izvanbračnoj ili životnoj zajednici ili neformalnoj životnoj zajednici s osobom kojoj je pružila pomoć ili je toj osobi srodnik po krvi u ravnoj lozi, brat ili sestra, posvojitelj ili posvojenik.  
Lažno prijavljivanje kaznenog djela

## Članak 304

(1) Tko prijavi neku osobu ili podmetne tragove koji upućuju na to da je počinila kazneno djelo, iako zna da to nije istina, a ne radi se o kaznenom djelu koje se progoni po privatnoj tužbi,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Tko lažnom prijavom, podmetanjem tragova ili na drugi način izazove pokretanje kaznenog postupka protiv osobe za koju zna da nije počinitelj kaznenog djela, a ne radi se o kaznenom djelu koje se progoni po privatnoj tužbi,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(3) Tko prijavi da je počinjeno kazneno djelo iako zna da to nije istina, a ne radi se o kaznenom djelu koje se progoni po privatnoj tužbi, ili tko sebe prijavi da je počinio takvo djelo iako zna da to nije istina,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
Davanje lažnog iskaza

## Članak 305

(1) Svjedok, vještak, prevoditelj ili tumač koji u prethodnom kaznenom postupku, u postupku pred sudom, međunarodnim sudom čiju sudbenost Republika Hrvatska prihvaća, arbitražom, u prekršajnom postupku, upravnom postupku, postupku pred javnim bilježnikom ili stegovnom postupku dade lažni iskaz, nalaz ili mišljenje ili nešto lažno prevede,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se stranka u postupku, osim okrivljenika, koja dade lažni iskaz ako se na tom iskazu temelji konačna odluka u tom postupku.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(3) Ako je kaznenim djelom iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka prouzročena osuda nedužnog okrivljenika ili druge osobito teške posljedice za okrivljenika,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
(4) Ako počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka dobrovoljno opozove svoj iskaz prije donošenja konačne odluke, može se osloboditi kazne.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda

## Article 297

(1) An official person who during an authorised hearing uses force, threat or other unlawful means or method with the aim that another person gives or refrains from giving a statement or other declaration,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) If by committing the criminal offence from paragraph 1 of this Article particularly severe consequences are caused for the suspect, accused or defendant in criminal proceedings,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
Unlawful search

## Article 298. (NN 56/15)

An official person who in the performance of duty or a responsible person who in the performance of public authority unlawfully carries out a search,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
Unlawful release of a person deprived of liberty

## Article 299

An official person who unlawfully releases a person deprived of liberty or helps them escape,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
Disclosure of official secret

## Article 300. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever without authorisation communicates to another, hands over or otherwise makes accessible data which are an official secret,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) There is no criminal offence if the act from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed predominantly in the public interest.  
Failure to report preparation of a criminal offence

## Article 301. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever knows that the commission of a criminal offence for which imprisonment of five years or a more severe punishment is prescribed is being prepared and does not report it at a time when it was still possible to prevent its commission, and the offence is attempted or committed,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.  
(2) Whoever commits the criminal offence from paragraph 1 of this Article regarding a criminal offence for which long-term imprisonment is prescribed,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(3) There is no criminal offence from paragraph 1 of this Article when its elements are fulfilled by a person who is married or who lives in an extramarital or life partnership or informal life partnership with the person who is preparing the unreported criminal offence or is related to that person by blood in direct line, brother or sister, adopter or adoptee, except if a criminal offence against a child is being prepared.  
(4) For the criminal offence from paragraph 2 of this Article, the perpetrator who is in one of the relationships from paragraph 3 of this Article with the person who is preparing the commission of the criminal offence may be punished more leniently.  
Failure to report a committed criminal offence

## Article 302. (NN 144/12, 56/15)

(1) Whoever knows that a criminal offence for which imprisonment of ten years or a more severe punishment is prescribed has been committed and does not report it although they know that such a report would enable or significantly facilitate the discovery of the offence or the perpetrator,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision, Decision, Decision, Decision
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on an official or responsible person who does not report the commission of a criminal offence of which they learned while performing their duty, and it concerns a criminal offence for which the initiation of criminal proceedings is not left to private prosecution or prosecution upon proposal.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment
(3) The perpetrator of the criminal offence from paragraph 2 of this Article shall not be punished by a punishment more severe than that prescribed for the criminal offence which they did not report.  
(4) There is no criminal offence from paragraph 1 of this Article when its legal elements are fulfilled by a person who is married or who lives in an extramarital or life partnership or informal life partnership with the person who committed the unreported criminal offence or is related to that person by blood in direct line, brother or sister, adopter or adoptee, except if the offence was committed against a child.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision, Decision, Decision
(5) There is no criminal offence from paragraph 1 and 2 of this Article when its legal elements are fulfilled by a religious confessor or a person who is obliged to keep a secret according to law.  
Assistance to the perpetrator after commission of a criminal offence

## Article 303. (NN 56/15)

(1) Whoever hides or shelters the perpetrator of a criminal offence for which imprisonment of five years or a more severe punishment is prescribed or by concealing the means by which the criminal offence was committed, traces of the criminal offence or objects created or obtained by the criminal offence or in another way helps them not to be discovered or arrested,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever hides a person who has been sentenced to imprisonment or in another way prevents the execution of that punishment.  
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence from paragraph 1 and 2 of this Article for the benefit of the perpetrator of a criminal offence from Article 88 to Article 91 or Article 97 of this Act,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
(4) The perpetrator of the criminal offence from paragraph 2 of this Article shall not be punished by a punishment more severe than that prescribed for the criminal offence committed by the person to whom the perpetrator provided assistance.  
(5) There is no criminal offence from paragraph 1, 2 and 3 of this Article when its legal elements are fulfilled by a person who is married or who lives in an extramarital or life partnership or informal life partnership with the person to whom they provided assistance or is related to that person by blood in direct line, brother or sister, adopter or adoptee.  
False reporting of a criminal offence

## Article 304

(1) Whoever reports a person or plants traces indicating that they committed a criminal offence, although they know that this is not true, and it does not concern a criminal offence prosecuted by private prosecution,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) Whoever by false reporting, planting traces or in another way causes the initiation of criminal proceedings against a person whom they know is not the perpetrator of the criminal offence, and it does not concern a criminal offence prosecuted by private prosecution,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
(3) Whoever reports that a criminal offence has been committed although they know that this is not true, and it does not concern a criminal offence prosecuted by private prosecution, or whoever reports themselves as having committed such an offence although they know that this is not true,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to one year.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
Giving false testimony

## Article 305

(1) A witness, expert, translator or interpreter who in preliminary criminal proceedings, in proceedings before a court, international court whose jurisdiction the Republic of Croatia accepts, arbitration, in misdemeanour proceedings, administrative proceedings, proceedings before a public notary or disciplinary proceedings gives false testimony, finding or opinion or falsely translates something,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on a party to the proceedings, except the accused, who gives false testimony if the final decision in those proceedings is based on that testimony.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment
(3) If by the criminal offence from paragraph 1 and 2 of this Article a conviction of an innocent accused or other particularly severe consequences for the accused are caused,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(4) If the perpetrator of the criminal offence from paragraph 1 of this Article voluntarily revokes their testimony before the final decision is made, they may be released from punishment.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment

## Članak 306

(1) Tko s ciljem da navede na davanje lažnog iskaza ili da spriječi ili oteža dokazivanje prema pretpostavljenom svjedoku, svjedoku ili vještaku u prethodnom kaznenom postupku, postupku pred sudom, međunarodnim sudom čiju sudbenost Republika Hrvatska prihvaća, arbitražom, u prekršajnom postupku, upravnom postupku, postupku pred javnim bilježnikom ili stegovnom postupku uporabi silu, prijetnju ili kakav drugi oblik prisile ili im obeća, nudi ili dade dar ili kakvu drugu korist,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(2) Tko s ciljem da spriječi ili znatno oteža dokazivanje u postupku pred sudom, međunarodnim sudom čiju sudbenost Republika Hrvatska prihvaća, arbitražom, u prekršajnom postupku, upravnom postupku, postupku pred javnim bilježnikom ili stegovnom postupku sakrije, ošteti ili uništi predmet ili ispravu koji služe dokazivanju, krivotvori dokaz, ili tko podnese takav dokaz znajući da je riječ o krivotvorini,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(3) Tko s ciljem da spriječi ili znatno oteža dokazivanje u postupku pred sudom ili u upravnom postupku ukloni, uništi, pomakne ili premjesti granični kamen, zemljomjerski znak, ili uopće znak o vlasništvu ili nekom drugom stvarnom pravu ili uporabi vode, ili tko s istim ciljem takav znak lažno postavi,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
Povreda tajnosti postupka

## Članak 307

(1) Tko neovlašteno otkrije ono što je saznao u prethodnom kaznenom postupku, postupku pred sudom, prekršajnom postupku, upravnom postupku, postupku pred javnim bilježnikom ili stegovnom postupku, a što se na temelju zakona ili odluke utemeljene na zakonu smatra tajnom,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko bez dozvole suda objavi tijek postupka koji je po zakonu tajan ili je odlukom suda proglašen tajnim, ili tko bez dozvole suda objavi tijek kaznenog postupka prema djetetu, kaznenog postupka za kazneno djelo počinjeno na štetu djeteta ili postupka u kojem se odlučuje o zaštiti prava i interesa djeteta ili objavi odluku u tom postupku.  
Otkrivanje identiteta ugrožene osobe ili zaštićenog svjedoka

## Članak 308

Tko neovlašteno drugome priopći, preda ili objavi podatke o identitetu ugrožene osobe ili osobe koja je ili će biti ispitana kao zaštićeni svjedok, ili za koju je na temelju posebnog zakona pokrenut postupak za uključenje u program zaštite ili je ta osoba uključena u program zaštite, ili tko poduzme drugu radnju s ciljem otkrivanja podataka o identitetu te osobe ili s ciljem njezinog pronalaska,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
Pobuna osoba kojima je oduzeta sloboda

## Članak 309

(1) Tko u ustanovi u kojoj se nalazi na temelju zakonite odluke kojom mu je oduzeta sloboda sudjeluje u okupljanju osoba kojima je oduzeta sloboda s ciljem da se nasilno oslobode, ili da zajednički napadnu službene osobe u toj ustanovi, ili da ih prisile da učine ili ne učine nešto protivno njihovoj dužnosti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Tko uporabom sile ili prijetnjom da će izravno napasti na život ili tijelo neke osobe pobjegne iz ustanove u kojoj se nalazi na temelju zakonite odluke kojom mu je oduzeta sloboda,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka koji na poziv službene osobe odustane od okupljanja, može se osloboditi kazne.  
Omogućavanje bijega osobi kojoj je oduzeta sloboda

## Članak 310

Tko osobu kojoj je na temelju zakona oduzeta sloboda potiče na bijeg ili joj pomaže u bijegu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
Neizvršavanje sudske odluke

## Članak 311. (NN 144/12, 126/19)

(1) Službena ili odgovorna osoba koja ne izvrši pravomoćnu sudsku odluku koju je bila dužna izvršiti, a time ne čini neko drugo kazneno djelo za koje je propisana teža kazna,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do dvije godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko krši sigurnosnu mjeru koja mu je određena pravomoćnom presudom.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko se ne pridržava samostalne mjere opreza koja mu je određena sudskom odlukom.  
(4) Nema kaznenog djela iz stavka 2. ovoga članka ako je kršenje obveze iz stavka 1. dovelo do primjene članka 55. stavka 9. ili članka 58. stavka 5. ovoga Zakona.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
Prisila prema pravosudnom dužnosniku

## Članak 312

Tko suca, državnog odvjetnika, javnog bilježnika ili drugog pravosudnog dužnosnika ili službenika silom ili prijetnjom kakvim zlom spriječi poduzeti neku radnju ili donijeti neku odluku u okviru njegovih ovlasti ili prisili na poduzimanje neke radnje ili donošenje neke odluke u okviru ili izvan njegove ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
Nadripisarstvo

## Članak 313

Tko se neovlašteno bavi pružanjem pravne pomoći uz naplatu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do šest mjeseci.  
Prisila prema službenoj osobi

## Članak 314. (NN 144/12)

(1) Tko silom ili prijetnjom da će izravno uporabiti silu spriječi službenu osobu u obavljanju službene radnje koja je u okviru njezinih ovlasti ili je prisili na obavljanje službene radnje u okviru ili izvan njezinih ovlasti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(2) Ako je kaznenim djelom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka doveden u opasnost život ili tijelo službene osobe ili joj je nanesena tjelesna ozljeda ili je uporabljeno oružje ili opasno oruđe,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Presuda, Rješenje, Rješenje
(3) Tko kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ili 2. ovoga članka počini prema osobi koja ovlašteno pomaže službenoj osobi u obavljanju službene radnje,
kaznit će se kao da je djelo počinio prema službenoj osobi.  
(4) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1., 2., i 3. ovoga članka koji je bio izazvan protuzakonitim, bezobzirnim ili osobito grubim postupanjem službene osobe ili osobe koja joj ovlašteno pomaže, može se osloboditi kazne.  
Napad na službenu osobu

## Članak 315. (NN 144/12)

(1) Tko silom ili prijetnjom uporabe sile izvan slučajeva iz članka 312. i članka 314. ovoga Zakona napadne vojnu osobu, policijskog službenika, ovlaštenu službenu osobu Vojne policije, službenu osobu kojoj je povjereno čuvanje osoba kojima je na temelju zakona oduzeta sloboda, kad obavljaju službenu dužnost,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko silom ili prijetnjom uporabe sile pruža otpor službenoj osobi u obavljanju njezine službene radnje ili u provođenju zakonite odluke ili mjere državnog tijela.  
(3) Tko kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka počini prema osobi koja ovlašteno pomaže službenoj osobi u obavljanju službene radnje,
kaznit će se kao da je djelo počinio prema službenoj osobi.  
(4) Ako je kaznenim djelom iz stavka 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka doveden u opasnost život ili tijelo službene osobe ili osobe koja joj pomaže u obavljanju službene radnje ili joj je nanesena tjelesna ozljeda ili je uporabljeno oružje ili opasno oruđe,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda
(5) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1., 2. i 3. ovoga članka koji je bio izazvan protuzakonitim, bezobzirnim ili osobito grubim postupanjem službene osobe ili osobe koja joj ovlašteno pomaže, može se osloboditi kazne.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Presuda, Presuda

## Article 306

(1) Whoever, with the aim of inducing false testimony or preventing or hindering evidence gathering, uses force, threat or any other form of coercion against a presumed witness, witness or expert witness in preliminary criminal proceedings, court proceedings, proceedings before an international court whose jurisdiction the Republic of Croatia accepts, arbitration, misdemeanour proceedings, administrative proceedings, proceedings before a public notary or disciplinary proceedings, or promises, offers or gives them a gift or any other benefit,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
(2) Whoever, with the aim of preventing or significantly hindering evidence gathering in proceedings before a court, an international court whose jurisdiction the Republic of Croatia accepts, arbitration, misdemeanour proceedings, administrative proceedings, proceedings before a public notary or disciplinary proceedings, conceals, damages or destroys an object or document serving as evidence, forges evidence, or submits such evidence knowing it to be a forgery,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
(3) Whoever, with the aim of preventing or significantly hindering evidence gathering in proceedings before a court or in administrative proceedings, removes, destroys, moves or relocates a boundary stone, surveying mark, or any mark indicating ownership or any other real right or water use, or whoever with the same aim falsely places such a mark,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
Violation of confidentiality of proceedings

## Article 307

(1) Whoever unlawfully discloses what they learned in preliminary criminal proceedings, court proceedings, misdemeanour proceedings, administrative proceedings, proceedings before a public notary or disciplinary proceedings, which is considered secret under law or a decision based on law,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, without court permission, publishes the course of proceedings that are secret by law or declared secret by court decision, or whoever, without court permission, publishes the course of criminal proceedings against a child, criminal proceedings for a criminal offence committed to the detriment of a child or proceedings deciding on the protection of the rights and interests of a child, or publishes a decision in such proceedings.  
Disclosure of identity of an endangered person or protected witness

## Article 308

Whoever unlawfully communicates, delivers or publishes to another person data on the identity of an endangered person or a person who is or will be examined as a protected witness, or for whom proceedings for inclusion in a protection programme have been initiated under special law or who has been included in a protection programme, or whoever undertakes another action with the aim of disclosing data on the identity of that person or with the aim of finding them,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
Rebellion of persons deprived of liberty

## Article 309

(1) Whoever, in an institution where they are located on the basis of a lawful decision depriving them of liberty, participates in a gathering of persons deprived of liberty with the aim of forcibly freeing themselves, or jointly attacking official persons in that institution, or forcing them to do or not do something contrary to their duty,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) Whoever, by use of force or threat to directly attack the life or body of any person, escapes from an institution where they are located on the basis of a lawful decision depriving them of liberty,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) The perpetrator of the criminal offence from paragraph 1. of this Article who, at the call of an official person, abandons the gathering, may be exempted from punishment.  
Enabling escape of a person deprived of liberty

## Article 310

Whoever incites a person lawfully deprived of liberty to escape or assists them in escaping,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to three years.  
Non-execution of court decision

## Article 311. (NN 144/12, 126/19)

(1) An official or responsible person who fails to execute a final court decision they were obliged to execute, and thereby does not commit another criminal offence for which a more severe penalty is prescribed,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to two years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever violates a security measure imposed on them by final judgment.  
(3) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever fails to comply with an independent precautionary measure imposed on them by court decision.  
(4) There is no criminal offence from paragraph 2. of this Article if the violation of the obligation from paragraph 1. led to the application of Article 55 paragraph 9. or Article 58 paragraph 5. of this Act.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment
Coercion against a judicial official

## Article 312

Whoever, by force or threat of any harm, prevents a judge, state attorney, public notary or other judicial official or employee from undertaking any action or making any decision within their authority, or coerces them into undertaking any action or making any decision within or outside their authority,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Unauthorized practice of law

## Article 313

Whoever unlawfully engages in providing legal assistance for payment,
shall be punished by imprisonment up to six months.  
Coercion against an official person

## Article 314. (NN 144/12)

(1) Whoever, by force or threat to directly use force, prevents an official person from performing an official action within their authority or coerces them into performing an official action within or outside their authority,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) If the criminal offence from paragraph 1. of this Article endangered the life or body of the official person or caused them bodily injury or a weapon or dangerous instrument was used,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision, Judgment, Decision, Decision
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence from paragraph 1. or 2. of this Article against a person lawfully assisting an official person in performing an official action,
shall be punished as if the offence was committed against an official person.  
(4) The perpetrator of the criminal offence from paragraph 1., 2., and 3. of this Article who was provoked by unlawful, reckless or particularly rough conduct of the official person or the person lawfully assisting them, may be exempted from punishment.  
Attack on an official person

## Article 315. (NN 144/12)

(1) Whoever, by force or threat of use of force, outside the cases from Article 312. and Article 314. of this Act, attacks a military person, police officer, authorized official person of the Military Police, an official person entrusted with guarding persons lawfully deprived of liberty, when they are performing official duty,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Decision
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1. of this Article shall be imposed on whoever, by force or threat of use of force, resists an official person in performing their official action or in implementing a lawful decision or measure of a state body.  
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence from paragraph 1. and 2. of this Article against a person lawfully assisting an official person in performing an official action,
shall be punished as if the offence was committed against an official person.  
(4) If the criminal offence from paragraph 1., 2. and 3. of this Article endangered the life or body of the official person or the person assisting them in performing an official action or caused them bodily injury or a weapon or dangerous instrument was used,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment
(5) The perpetrator of the criminal offence from paragraph 1., 2. and 3. of this Article who was provoked by unlawful, reckless or particularly rough conduct of the official person or the person lawfully assisting them, may be exempted from punishment.  
JUDICIAL PRACTICE: Judgment, Judgment

## Članak 315.a (NN 118/18)

(1) Tko doktora medicine, doktora dentalne medicine ili drugog zdravstvenog radnika koji zdravstvenu djelatnost obavlja kao javnu službu silom ili prijetnjom da će izravno uporabiti silu spriječi u obavljanju njegove zdravstvene djelatnosti, kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Ako je kaznenim djelom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka doveden u opasnost život ili tijelo doktora medicine, doktora dentalne medicine ili drugog zdravstvenog radnika ili mu je nanesena tjelesna ozljeda ili je uporabljeno oružje ili opasno oruđe, počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka koji je bio izazvan protuzakonitim, bezobzirnim ili grubim postupanjem doktora medicine, doktora dentalne medicine ili drugog zdravstvenog radnika može se osloboditi kazne.  
Prisila prema osobi koja obavlja poslove od javnog interesa ili u javnoj službi

## Članak 315.b (NN 126/19)

(1) Tko osobu u obavljanju poslova od javnog interesa ili javnog službenika u obavljanju javne službe silom ili prijetnjom da će izravno uporabiti silu spriječi u obavljanju poslova od javnog interesa ili javne službe, kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Ako je kaznenim djelom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka doveden u opasnost život ili tijelo osobe koja obavlja poslove od javnog interesa ili javnog službenika ili mu je nanesena tjelesna ozljeda ili je uporabljeno oružje ili opasno oruđe, počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Počinitelj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka koji je bio izazvan protuzakonitim, bezobzirnim ili grubim postupanjem osobe koja obavlja poslove od javnog interesa ili javnog službenika može se osloboditi kazne.  
Lažna uzbuna

## Članak 316

Tko lažno obavijesti policiju ili drugu javnu službu koja osigurava red ili pruža pomoć o događaju koji iziskuje hitno djelovanje te službe,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Rješenje, Rješenje
Skidanje i povreda službenog pečata i znaka

## Članak 317

(1) Tko skine ili povrijedi službeni pečat ili znak koji je ovlaštena službena osoba stavila radi osiguranja predmeta, prostorije ili prostora, ili tko bez skidanja ili povrede pečata ili znaka uđe u takav prostor ili prostoriju ili otvori osigurani predmet,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
Oduzimanje ili uništenje službenog pečata ili službenog spisa

## Članak 318

(1) Tko protupravno oduzme, sakrije, uništi, ošteti ili na drugi način učini neuporabljivim službeni pečat, knjigu, spis ili ispravu,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Ako djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počini službena osoba kojoj je službeni pečat, knjiga, spis ili isprava povjerena ili bila dostupna u obavljanju njezine službene dužnosti,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
Oštećenje i nedozvoljeni izvoz kulturnog dobra

## Članak 319

(1) Tko ošteti ili uništi kulturno dobro,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Kaznom iz stavka 1. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko bez odobrenja nadležnog tijela trajno izveze ili iznese iz Republike Hrvatske kulturno dobro ili ga ne vrati u Republiku Hrvatsku u roku određenom odobrenjem.  
(3) Ako je zbog kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka nastupila znatna šteta ili se radi o kulturnom dobru od nacionalnog značenja,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(4) Za pokušaj kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka počinitelj će se kazniti.  
Nedozvoljeno obavljanje istraživačkih radova i prisvajanje kulturnog dobra

## Članak 320

(1) Tko protivno zabrani ili bez odobrenja nadležnog tijela na kulturnom dobru obavi konzervatorske, restauratorske, istraživačke ili druge radove, arheološka iskopavanja ili istraživanja, pa zbog toga kulturno dobro bude uništeno, oštećeno ili izgubi svojstvo kulturnog dobra,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Ako je kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinjeno prema kulturnom dobru od nacionalnog značenja ili je prouzročena znatna šteta,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Kaznom iz stavka 2. ovoga članka kaznit će se tko prigodom arheoloških ili drugih istraživanja prisvoji iskopan ili nađen predmet koji predstavlja kulturno dobro.  
Uništavanje ili prikrivanje arhivskog gradiva

## Članak 321

Tko protivno propisima uništi, prikriva ili učini neuporabljivom arhivsko ili registraturno gradivo, ili ga iznese iz Republike Hrvatske bez odobrenja nadležnog državnog tijela,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
Neovlašteno obavljanje službene radnje

## Članak 322

Tko neovlašteno izvrši kakvu radnju koju je ovlaštena izvršiti samo službena ili vojna osoba,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do jedne godine
Protupravna naplata

## Članak 323

(1) Tko od drugog silom ili ozbiljnom prijetnjom naplati tražbinu koju ovaj duguje njemu ili drugoj osobi,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(2) Ako je pri počinjenju kaznenog djela iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinitelj uporabio silu ili prijetnju da će izravno napasti na život ili tijelo dužnika ili druge osobe,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora od jedne do osam godina.  
(3) Ako je pri počinjenju kaznenog djela iz stavka 2. ovoga članka uporabljeno oružje ili opasno oruđe,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od jedne do deset godina.  
Nasilničko ponašanje

## Članak 323.a (NN 56/15)

Tko nasiljem, zlostavljanjem, iživljavanjem ili drugim osobito drskim ponašanjem na javnom mjestu drugoga dovede u ponižavajući položaj, a time nije počinjeno teže kazneno djelo,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
SUDSKA PRAKSA: Odluka Ustavnog suda, Rješenje
Izazivanje nereda 87

## Članak 324

(1) Tko sudjeluje u mnoštvu koje nasiljem prema drugim osobama ili stvarima ili prijetnjom da će počiniti nasilje ugrožava javni red ili potiče mnoštvo na nasilje,
kaznit će se kaznom zatvora do tri godine.  
(2) Ako je kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinjeno iz mržnje, prema većem broju osoba, uz uporabu oružja ili opasnog oruđa ili dovede u opasnost život ili tijelo druge osobe ili je dovelo do znatne imovinske štete,
počinitelj će se kazniti kaznom zatvora od šest mjeseci do pet godina.  
(3) Sudionik iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka koji se udalji na zahtjev službene osobe prije nego što je sam počinio nasilje neće se kazniti za kazneno djelo iz stavka 1. i 2. ovoga članka.  
Javno poticanje na nasilje i mržnju

## Article 315.a (NN 118/18)

(1) Whoever by force or threat to directly use force prevents a doctor of medicine, doctor of dental medicine or other health worker who performs health activity as a public service from performing his health activity, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) If the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article has endangered the life or body of a doctor of medicine, doctor of dental medicine or other health worker or has caused him bodily injury or a weapon or dangerous instrument has been used, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) The perpetrator of the criminal offense from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article who was provoked by unlawful, reckless or rough conduct of a doctor of medicine, doctor of dental medicine or other health worker may be exempted from punishment.  
Coercion against a person performing tasks of public interest or in public service

## Article 315.b (NN 126/19)

(1) Whoever by force or threat to directly use force prevents a person performing tasks of public interest or a public official in performing public service from performing tasks of public interest or public service, shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) If the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article has endangered the life or body of a person performing tasks of public interest or a public official or has caused him bodily injury or a weapon or dangerous instrument has been used, the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) The perpetrator of the criminal offense from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article who was provoked by unlawful, reckless or rough conduct of a person performing tasks of public interest or a public official may be exempted from punishment.  
False alarm

## Article 316

Whoever falsely notifies the police or other public service that ensures order or provides assistance about an event that requires urgent action by that service,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Decision, Decision
Removal and violation of official seal and sign

## Article 317

(1) Whoever removes or violates an official seal or sign that an authorized official person has placed to secure an object, premises or space, or whoever without removing or violating the seal or sign enters such space or premises or opens the secured object,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
Seizure or destruction of official seal or official document

## Article 318

(1) Whoever unlawfully seizes, conceals, destroys, damages or otherwise renders unusable an official seal, book, document or certificate,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) If the act from paragraph 1 of this Article is committed by an official person to whom the official seal, book, document or certificate was entrusted or was accessible in the performance of his official duty,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
Damage and unauthorized export of cultural property

## Article 319

(1) Whoever damages or destroys cultural property,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) The punishment from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever without permission of the competent authority permanently exports or takes out of the Republic of Croatia cultural property or does not return it to the Republic of Croatia within the time limit determined by the permission.  
(3) If due to the criminal offense from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article considerable damage has occurred or it concerns cultural property of national significance,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(4) For an attempt of the criminal offense from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article the perpetrator shall be punished.  
Unauthorized performance of research works and appropriation of cultural property

## Article 320

(1) Whoever contrary to prohibition or without permission of the competent authority performs conservation, restoration, research or other works, archaeological excavations or research on cultural property, and due to this the cultural property is destroyed, damaged or loses the quality of cultural property,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) If the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed against cultural property of national significance or considerable damage was caused,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) The punishment from paragraph 2 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever during archaeological or other research appropriates an excavated or found object that represents cultural property.  
Destruction or concealment of archival material

## Article 321

Whoever contrary to regulations destroys, conceals or renders unusable archival or registry material, or takes it out of the Republic of Croatia without permission of the competent state authority,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Unauthorized performance of official action

## Article 322

Whoever without authorization performs any action that only an official or military person is authorized to perform,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to one year
Unlawful collection

## Article 323

(1) Whoever by force or serious threat collects from another a claim that he owes to him or another person,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) If in committing the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article the perpetrator used force or threat to directly attack the life or body of the debtor or another person,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
(3) If in committing the criminal offense from paragraph 2 of this Article a weapon or dangerous instrument was used,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
Violent behavior

## Article 323.a (NN 56/15)

Whoever by violence, abuse, harassment or other particularly insolent behavior in a public place puts another in a humiliating position, and thereby a more serious criminal offense has not been committed,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
CASE LAW: Decision of the Constitutional Court, Decision
Causing disorder 87

## Article 324

(1) Whoever participates in a crowd that by violence against other persons or things or by threat to commit violence endangers public order or incites the crowd to violence,
shall be punished by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) If the criminal offense from paragraph 1 of this Article was committed out of hatred, against a larger number of persons, with the use of a weapon or dangerous instrument or endangers the life or body of another person or has led to considerable property damage,
the perpetrator shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(3) A participant from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article who moves away at the request of an official person before he himself committed violence shall not be punished for the criminal offense from paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.  
Public incitement to violence and hatred

shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever enters into the voters' list a non-existent person, deceased person or person who does not have voting rights.  
CASE LAW: Judgment, Judgment, Judgment, Judgment
Electoral fraud

## Article 338

Whoever by adding, subtracting, deleting votes or in another manner falsifies the result of elections,
shall be punished by imprisonment from six months to five years.  
Bribery of representatives

## Article 339. (NN 56/15, 114/23)

(1) Whoever as a representative in the Croatian Parliament, European Parliament, legislative body or representative body of a foreign state or international public organization or as a councillor in the representative body of a unit of local and regional self-government demands or receives a bribe or accepts an offer or promise of a bribe for themselves or another in order to vote in a certain way in the legislative or representative body, shall be punished by imprisonment from one to eight years.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever offers, promises or gives a bribe intended for that or another person to a representative in the Croatian Parliament, European Parliament, in the legislative body or representative body of a foreign state or international public organization or to a councillor in the representative body of a unit of local and regional self-government in order for them to vote in a certain way in the legislative or representative body or whoever intermediates in such bribery.  
(3) A foreign state in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article includes all levels of government of that state or organized foreign territory.  
High treason

## Article 340

Whoever by use of force or threat of use of force or in another unlawful manner endangers the territorial integrity or constitutional order of the Republic of Croatia,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least five years.  
Recognition of occupation and capitulation

## Article 341

Whoever signs or recognizes capitulation or whoever accepts or recognizes occupation of the Republic of Croatia or part of its state territory,
shall be punished by imprisonment of at least five years.  
Prevention of combat against the enemy

## Article 342

(1) A citizen of the Republic of Croatia who during war or armed conflict in which the Republic of Croatia also participates prevents citizens of the Republic of Croatia or its allies from fighting against the enemy,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
(2) A citizen of the Republic of Croatia within the meaning of this chapter is also a foreigner with residence in the Republic of Croatia.  
Service in enemy army

## Article 343

(1) A citizen of the Republic of Croatia who during war or armed conflict in which the Republic of Croatia participates serves in the enemy army or is in other armed groups that act in enemy combat against the Republic of Croatia or its allies,
shall be punished by imprisonment from three to fifteen years.  
(2) The penalty from paragraph 1 of this Article shall be imposed on whoever incites, collects, takes away, or otherwise recruits citizens of the Republic of Croatia for service in the enemy army, or armed groups that act in enemy combat against the Republic of Croatia or its allies or for participation in war or armed conflict against the Republic of Croatia or its allies.  
Aiding the enemy

## Article 344

A citizen of the Republic of Croatia who during war or armed conflict in which the Republic of Croatia participates aids the enemy in implementing coercive measures against citizens or who politically or economically cooperates with the enemy,
shall be punished by imprisonment from one to ten years.  
Undermining military and defense power of the state
